No a11y field anywhere (`rg -n 'a11y|A11y' crates/ftui-runtime/src/program.rs` returns nothing).
- `crates/ftui-runtime/src/telemetry_schema.rs` targets: `ftui.runtime` :35, `ftui.effect` :38, `ftui.process` :41, `ftui.decision.resize` :44, `ftui.voi` :47, `ftui.bocpd` :50, `ftui.eprocess` :53; no `ftui.a11y`.
- Showcase: `crates/ftui-demo-showcase/src/screens/accessibility_panel.rs` (571 lines) holds `a11y: theme::A11ySettings`, `events: VecDeque<A11yEventEntry>` of `A11yEventKind` telemetry, `layout_toggles`; snapshots `accessibility_panel_initial_80x24.snap`, `a11y_accessibility_panel_{all_modes_120x40,high_contrast_80x24,large_text_80x24,reduced_motion_80x24}.snap`; tests `tests/a11y_snapshots.rs` (has `a11y_transition` cases), `tests/a11y_modes_ux_a11y.rs`; `scripts/a11y_transitions_e2e.sh` runs `cargo test -p ftui-demo-showcase --test a11y_snapshots -- a11y_transition` with `E2E_JSONL=1`; `tests/e2e/scripts/test_a11y_modes.sh` writes `a11y_modes.jsonl`. `docs/ACCESSIBILITY.md` (8 KB) describes the crate and calls the tree "Phase 2 complete".
- ftui-demo-showcase Cargo.toml does not depend on ftui-a11y (only ftui-widgets does).

## Target state

`ftui-render` depends on `ftui-a11y`; `Frame` carries `a11y: Option<&'a mut A11yTreeBuilder>` plus `push_a11y(node)` and `with_a11y_scope(role, area, f)`; the nine widgets push their nodes in `render`; `Block` wraps children in a scope so nesting is recorded; `ProgramConfig::with_accessibility(bool)` (default off, showcase on) makes `Program` own a builder, reset it per frame, build the tree after `view()`, diff against `last_a11y_tree: Arc<A11yTree>`, emit `a11y_announcement` evidence for live-region and focus changes, and call `Model::on_accessibility_tree(&Arc<A11yTree>)` (default no-op); the showcase `accessibility_panel` renders the tree as an indented role/name/state list and keeps its toggles. `ftui.a11y` becomes a `telemetry_schema` target.

## Success criteria

- [ ] `crates/ftui-render/src/frame.rs` unit test `push_a11y_collects_nodes_in_render_order_with_block_nesting`: a `Frame` with a builder, two pushes inside `with_a11y_scope(A11yRole::Group, ..)`, asserts the built tree has 3 nodes, children's parent id is the scope node id, and order is preserved.
- [ ] Snapshot `dashboard_a11y_tree_80x24.snap` (text dump of the tree built from the dashboard screen at 80x24).
- [ ] `A11yTreeDiff` announcement test: focus move between two `TextInput`s produces exactly one `a11y_announcement` with `reason = "focus_changed"` and the target's name.
- [ ] Evidence line `a11y_announcement` written through the sink; `TARGET_A11Y = "ftui.a11y"` in `telemetry_schema.rs` and used by the runtime's a11y tracing.
- [ ] `scripts/a11y_transitions_e2e.sh` extended to assert announcements for Tab navigation in the forms screen (`g09-e2e`).
- [ ] Reachability gate shows `ftui-a11y` reachable from ftui-render and ftui-runtime.

## Implementation plan (child beads)

1. `g09-impl`: ftui-render dependency + `Frame` hooks.
2. `g09-impl-widgets`: nine widgets push nodes; `Block` scopes children.
3. `g09-impl-runtime`: `ProgramConfig::with_accessibility`, per-frame build/diff, `a11y_announcement` evidence, `Model::on_accessibility_tree` hook.
4. `g09-impl-showcase`: `accessibility_panel` renders the tree.
5. `g09-tests`: unit, snapshot, diff/announcement tests.
6. `g09-e2e`: `scripts/a11y_transitions_e2e.sh` extension.
7. `g09-docs`: README Accessibility section, `docs/ACCESSIBILITY.md`, telemetry spec.

## Dependencies and ordering

- `g09-impl-runtime` is blocked by `g20-impl` (cluster D owns the evidence writer and the canonical event-name list; `a11y_announcement` must be registered there).
- `g07-impl` is not required (nothing here is quarantined).
- Unblocks: G04.9 a11y-related PTY cases, `g20-impl`'s schema validation for the new event, `g06-impl` ledger row for V46.

## Considerations, risks, alternatives rejected

- Why hooks on `Frame` rather than a separate a11y pass: widgets already know their area and state at render time; a second traversal would need a widget tree that FrankenTUI does not keep (widgets are values rendered by `view()`).
- Why `Option<&mut A11yTreeBuilder>` and not always-on: building the map every frame costs allocations; consumers who do not enable it pay nothing (the `Option` check is one branch per widget).
- Node ids: widgets need stable ids across frames for diffing; the existing `WidgetSignal.widget_id: u64` (`frame.rs:322`) and `HitId` conventions are reused where a widget already has an id; otherwise the id is derived from `(role, area)` hash with a documented caveat that moving widgets read as remove+add.
- Risk: `Block` nesting requires every container to use `with_a11y_scope`; only `Block` is done here, other containers (Modal stack, Tabs content) are follow-ups noted in `g09-impl-widgets`.
- Risk: showcase snapshots for screens using the nine widgets do not change (pushing nodes does not draw), but the reachability of `ftui_a11y` from `ftui-render` changes the dependency graph: `cargo tree -p ftui-render` must show no cycle.
- Rollback: `with_accessibility(false)` at runtime; the `Frame` field defaults to `None`.

## Definition of done

All child beads closed; the tree is built and diffed in the showcase with the panel showing it; snapshot and E2E evidence committed; README and docs truthful; close reason lists test names, snapshot file, and the E2E JSONL fields observed.

title: task(G09): ftui-render depends on ftui-a11y; Frame gains push_a11y, with_a11y_scope, finish_a11y
description:
## Context and why this matters

The accessibility tree (README "## Accessibility", README.md:2290-2300; vision row V46) is never built because `Frame` (`crates/ftui-render/src/frame.rs:425`) has no place to collect the nodes that nine widgets already know how to produce (`ftui_a11y::Accessible::accessibility_nodes`, `crates/ftui-a11y/src/lib.rs:117`). This bead adds the collection point: ftui-render depends on ftui-a11y, `Frame` gains an optional tree builder reference, a `push_a11y` method, and a scoped-container helper mirroring the existing `with_hit_owner` pattern. It is the foundation for `g09-impl-widgets` and `g09-impl-runtime`; it serves V46 and Section 2.2.B.

## Current state (evidence)

- `crates/ftui-render/Cargo.toml` `[dependencies]`: `ahash`, `bitflags`, `memchr`, `smallvec`, `unicode-segmentation`, `web-time`, `bumpalo`, `ftui-core` (path), optional `tracing`; comment says ftui-render must not depend on ftui-style (ftui-style depends on ftui-render). `ftui-a11y` depends only on `ftui-core` and `ahash` (`crates/ftui-a11y/Cargo.toml`), so `ftui-render -> ftui-a11y -> ftui-core` introduces no cycle.
- `crates/ftui-render/src/frame.rs`: `pub struct Frame<'a>` :425 with public fields `buffer`, `pool: &'a mut GraphemePool`, `links: Option<&'a mut LinkRegistry>`, `hit_grid: Option<HitGrid>`, private `hit_owner_stack: Vec<HitOwner>`, `widget_budget: WidgetBudget`, `widget_signals: Vec<WidgetSignal>`, `cursor_position`, `cursor_visible`, `degradation: DegradationLevel`, `arena: Option<&'a FrameArena>`; constructors `new(width, height, pool)` :477, `with_links(...)` :516, `with_hit_grid(width, height, pool)` :540; accessors `arena()` :579, `register_link` :586, `widget_signals()` :612; scoped helper `with_hit_owner<R>(&mut self, owner: HitOwner, f: impl FnOnce(&mut Self) -> R) -> R` :731 (push owner, run `f`, pop).
- `crates/ftui-a11y/src/tree.rs`: `A11yTreeBuilder` :25 (`nodes: AHashMap<u64, A11yNodeInfo>`, `root: Option<u64>`, `focused: Option<u64>`; `new` :40, `with_capacity`, `add_node` :60 inserts or replaces by `node.id`, `set_root`, `set_focused`, `build` :78). `crates/ftui-a11y/src/node.rs`: `A11yNodeInfo::new(id: u64, role: A11yRole, bounds: Rect)` :210 with builder methods (`with_name`, children/parent setters: read `node.rs:184-273` for the exact names before coding).
- Node ordering: `A11yTreeBuilder` stores a map, so render order is not preserved by the builder itself; `Frame` must keep an ordered `Vec<u64>` of pushed ids if order matters for the dump/snapshot (it does: screen readers read in document order).

## Target state

`Frame` has `pub a11y: Option<&'a mut A11yTreeBuilder>`, a private `a11y_scope_stack: Vec<u64>`, and a private `a11y_order: Vec<u64>` (ids in push order; exposed by `a11y_order() -> &[u64]`). `push_a11y(&mut self, mut node: A11yNodeInfo)` sets the node's parent to the top of the scope stack (if any), appends the node id to the current scope's children list (via the builder: fetch-modify-reinsert the parent node, or keep a local parent->children map applied at `finish`), records the id in `a11y_order`, and calls `builder.add_node(node)`; when `a11y` is `None` it is a no-op returning immediately. `with_a11y_scope<R>(&mut self, node: A11yNodeInfo, f: impl FnOnce(&mut Self) -> R) -> R` pushes the container node (as a normal `push_a11y`), pushes its id on the scope stack, runs `f`, pops. `Frame::a11y_enabled(&self) -> bool`. A new constructor variant is not needed: callers set `frame.a11y = Some(&mut builder)` after `Frame::new` (the runtime does this in `g09-impl-runtime`), mirroring how `links` is set by `with_links`/`set_links`.

## Implementation plan

1. `crates/ftui-render/Cargo.toml`: add `ftui-a11y = { path = "../ftui-a11y", version = "0.6.0" }` under `[dependencies]`; update the comment block to state the allowed dependency set (core, a11y).
2. `crates/ftui-render/src/frame.rs`: add the three fields to `Frame` (initialize in `new`, `with_links`, `with_hit_grid`; `a11y: None`, empty vecs); add `push_a11y`, `with_a11y_scope`, `a11y_enabled`, `a11y_order`, and `take_a11y_order(&mut self) -> Vec<u64>` (for the runtime to move the order out, mirroring `take_widget_signals` used at `program.rs:6582`). Parent/children wiring: since `A11yNodeInfo` carries parent/children ids (per `tree.rs:94-99` doc: "parent/child relationships are encoded inside each A11yNodeInfo"), implement `push_a11y` as: set `node.parent = scope_top`; `builder.add_node(node)`; if `scope_top` is `Some(p)`, record `(p, id)` in a private `pending_children: Vec<(u64, u64)>`; `finish_a11y(&mut self)` (called by the runtime before `build`) applies `pending_children` by re-reading each parent from the builder (`A11yTreeBuilder` has no getter today: add `pub fn node_mut(&mut self, id: u64) -> Option<&mut A11yNodeInfo>` to `tree.rs`, a 3-line addition) and pushing child ids. Keep the fetch inside `push_a11y` if `node_mut` makes it simpler; either way, no second map of nodes in `Frame`.
3. `crates/ftui-a11y/src/tree.rs`: add `node_mut` (and `pub fn len(&self)`/`is_empty` if missing) to `A11yTreeBuilder`; add `A11yTree::dump_text(&self, order: &[u64]) -> String` producing one line per node in `order`: `{indent}{role:?} "{name}" [{states}] @{x},{y} {w}x{h}` with indent = depth from parent chain; this is the format the snapshot and the showcase panel use (one implementation, two consumers).
4. Doc comments on the new `Frame` API stating: nodes must carry stable ids across frames for diffing (reuse `WidgetSignal.widget_id`/`HitId` where available; otherwise `A11yNodeInfo::stable_id_for(role, area)` helper added in `node.rs` that hashes `(role as u8, x, y, w, h)` with `ahash`, documented caveat that moving widgets show as remove+add).
5. Unit tests in `frame.rs` (see `g09-tests` for names) including the no-op path when `a11y` is `None`.
6. Gates: `cargo check --workspace --all-targets`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo tree -p ftui-render | rg ftui-` shows only `ftui-core` and `ftui-a11y`; `ubs` on touched files.

What NOT to do: no separate "a11y frame" type; no always-on tree; no changes to widgets here (`g09-impl-widgets`); no runtime changes here (`g09-impl-runtime`).

## Files to change

- `crates/ftui-render/Cargo.toml`: dependency.
- `crates/ftui-render/src/frame.rs`: fields, `push_a11y`, `with_a11y_scope`, `finish_a11y`, `take_a11y_order`, `a11y_enabled`, tests.
- `crates/ftui-a11y/src/tree.rs`: `node_mut`, `dump_text`.
- `crates/ftui-a11y/src/node.rs`: `stable_id_for(role, area)`.

## Success criteria

- [ ] `push_a11y_collects_nodes_in_render_order_with_block_nesting` passes (3 nodes; child parents == scope id; `a11y_order` == push order).
- [ ] `push_a11y_is_noop_without_builder` passes (no panic, `a11y_order` empty).
- [ ] `dump_text_indents_by_depth` in `tree.rs` passes with a 3-level tree.
- [ ] `cargo tree -p ftui-render` shows no cycle; `cargo check -p ftui-render --no-default-features` green (ftui-a11y has no features to break).
- [ ] The ftui-render `Frame` docs (`cargo doc -p ftui-render`) build without warnings.

## Tests and logging

- Unit: as above plus `nested_scopes_three_deep_record_ancestry` and `finish_a11y_applies_pending_children_once` (calling `finish_a11y` twice does not duplicate child ids).
- Bench: none (an `Option` branch per widget; G25's `frame_render` row guards regressions).
- Logging: none in ftui-render (no tracing on this path; the runtime logs).

## Dependencies and ordering

- Blocked by: nothing.
- Unblocks: `g09-impl-widgets`, `g09-impl-runtime`, `g09-tests`.

## Considerations, risks, alternatives rejected

- Alternative rejected: making `Frame` own an `A11yTreeBuilder` by value. The runtime must keep the previous tree for diffing and reset the builder per frame; a borrowed builder keeps ownership in `Program` (same pattern as `links`/`pool`).
- Alternative rejected: collecting `Vec<A11yNodeInfo>` in `Frame` and building the tree in the runtime. Equivalent, but `with_a11y_scope` needs parent ids at push time, which the builder's map provides.
- Risk: `A11yTreeBuilder::add_node` replaces by id; two widgets with the same derived id in one frame silently merge. `push_a11y` debug-asserts uniqueness within a frame (`a11y_order` contains check in debug builds only).

## Definition of done

Dependency added, `Frame` API implemented with tests, `dump_text` implemented, gates and `ubs` clean; close reason lists the test names and the `cargo tree` line.
close_reason: Landed (commit d8721796): ftui-render depends on ftui-a11y; Frame gains a11y builder slot (set_a11y/a11y_enabled), push_a11y (scope parent default, explicit parent kept), push_a11y_nodes, with_a11y_scope (catch_unwind-safe), finish_a11y (children wired, first parentless node becomes root), a11y_order/take_a11y_order. ftui-a11y: builder root/node/node_mut/len/is_empty + Debug/Clone, A11yTree::dump_text(order), A11yNodeInfo::stable_id_for. Tests: frame_a11y_is_a_noop_without_a_builder, frame_a11y_collects_nodes_with_scope_parents_and_a_root, stable_a11y_ids_depend_on_role_and_bounds_only; ftui-a11y suite green. Widget pushes (13.2) follow in the next commit.

title: G46: Implement one real assistive-technology host bridge
description:
The project has an in-process accessibility tree and ARIA-shaped Rust exports but no actual OS screen-reader bridge. Define an explicit supported host boundary first: a terminal application does not own the emulator's accessibility tree. Evaluate host-owned integration or an explicit local adapter protocol, document capabilities and limitations, then implement one usable end-to-end bridge using existing hooks. Handle focus/actions and live announcements without routing them to ordinary logs. A prototype scope decision must result in a deliverable host path or a precise unsupported boundary, never an unsupported blanket 'screen-reader support' claim. Preserve later host expansion as roadmap scope; no fake DOM/OS fixtures qualify as real delivery.

Verification contract (companion task):
On one named real assistive technology and host version, demonstrate navigation, editable input/selection, modal focus restoration, command selection and polite/assertive announcements. Record host/AT versions, feature flags, actions and expected/observed outcomes, redacting user content. Automate the bridge transport/action contract where possible; distinguish manual AT evidence from automated checks and keep both reproducible. Test disconnect/reconnect, malformed actions, bounded backpressure and disabled mode. Confirm accessibility-only content does not appear in normal tracing/export.

Context: September 4 reality check at 21a4e48b. Source and shipped 0.6.0 are different evidence domains. Preserve all current functionality and in-progress ownership; no file deletion, yanking, publishing, or compatibility shims are authorized by this task. Use existing files where coherent, manual edits, Cargo only. Acceptance must identify exact commit, feature set, target, toolchain, command, exit status and artifact hashes; skipped/missing evidence remains unproven. Run the relevant unit/property and real integration/E2E checks, archive diagnostic logs with seeds and bounded redacted payloads, and run workspace check, Clippy -D warnings, fmt --check and rustdoc -D warnings for substantive Rust changes. Do not close on compilation alone.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Implement the complete scoped contract without losing existing functionality.
- [ ] Unit/property and error-boundary checks specified below pass.
- [ ] Companion real integration/E2E proof is linked with exact provenance and useful redacted logs.
- [ ] Apply the ambition-regeneration boundary and evidence requirements in the notes; preserve both successes and failures.
notes: Ambition regeneration: bind actual AT/host evidence to exact bridge/source version; exercise disconnect/reconnect, real editable selection and action dispatch. Keep manual verification explicitly manual. One supported host is the first milestone; never infer all OS/browser support.

title: task(G09): Nine Accessible widgets push nodes in render; Block::render_with_children scopes children
description:
## Context and why this matters

Nine widgets already describe themselves for assistive technology through `ftui_a11y::Accessible::accessibility_nodes(&self, area) -> Vec<A11yNodeInfo>` (`crates/ftui-a11y/src/lib.rs:117`), but nothing calls that method in production (reality check Section 2.2.B, V46). Once `Frame` has `push_a11y` (`g09-impl`), each widget's `render` must hand its nodes to the frame so the runtime can build the tree. `Block` is the container primitive, so it must scope its child rendering with `with_a11y_scope` for the tree to have structure instead of a flat list. This bead is the widget half of making README "## Accessibility" (README.md:2290-2300) true.

## Current state (evidence)

- `impl ftui_a11y::Accessible for` sites: `crates/ftui-widgets/src/block.rs:440` (`Block<'_>`), `tabs.rs:518` (`Tabs<'_>`), `progress.rs:209` (`ProgressBar<'_>`), `input.rs:1155` (`TextInput`), `list.rs:973` (`List<'_>`), `table.rs:332` (`Table<'_>`), `spinner.rs:187` (`Spinner<'_>`), `scrollbar.rs:540` (`Scrollbar<'_>`), `paragraph.rs:582` (`Paragraph<'_>`). Each `fn accessibility_nodes(&self, area: Rect) -> Vec<ftui_a11y::node::A11yNodeInfo>` builds nodes from the widget's own state; `paragraph.rs:1128-1176` has unit tests for its nodes.
- `crates/ftui-widgets/Cargo.toml:27` already depends on ftui-a11y.
- Widget traits (`crates/ftui-widgets/src/lib.rs`, per AGENTS.md Core Types): `Widget::render(&self, area, frame)` and `StatefulWidget::render(&self, area, frame, state)`. `Block` renders borders/title and exposes `inner(area)` for children; children are rendered by the caller after `Block::render` (there is no closure-based child rendering in `Block`), so "scoping children" must be done where a caller renders into `block.inner(area)`.
- `TextInput` (`input.rs`) has focus state; `List`/`Table` have selection state; `Tabs` has the selected index; `ProgressBar` has value/range; `Spinner` is a live region candidate (busy); `Scrollbar` has value range; `Paragraph` is static text.

## Target state

Every one of the nine `render` implementations calls `frame.push_a11y(node)` for each node from `self.accessibility_nodes(area)` (when `frame.a11y_enabled()`), using ids that are stable across frames. `Block` gains `pub fn render_with_children(&self, area: Rect, frame: &mut Frame, f: impl FnOnce(&mut Frame, Rect))` that renders the block, then runs `f(frame, self.inner(area))` inside `frame.with_a11y_scope(block_node, ..)` so children nest under the block's `Group`/`Region` node; the showcase and the nine widgets' own internal blocks use it. `Spinner` and `ProgressBar` nodes carry `LiveRegion::Polite` (busy/progress announcements); `TextInput` sets `A11yState.focused` from its focus flag so focus diffs work.

## Implementation plan

1. Read each `accessibility_nodes` impl to learn which node ids it uses today; where an id is derived from nothing stable (e.g. `0` or a counter), switch to `A11yNodeInfo::stable_id_for(role, area)` (from `g09-impl`) or to the widget's existing `HitId`/`widget_id` when it has one (`VirtualizedList` has `hit_id`; `Table`/`List` may have ids through `WidgetSignal`; check each file).
2. In each of the nine `render` impls, after drawing, add:
   ```rust
   if frame.a11y_enabled() {
       for node in ftui_a11y::Accessible::accessibility_nodes(self, area) {
           frame.push_a11y(node);
       }
   }
   ```
   (a small private helper `fn push_accessibility_nodes<W: ftui_a11y::Accessible + ?Sized>(widget: &W, area: Rect, frame: &mut Frame)` in `crates/ftui-widgets/src/lib.rs` avoids nine copies; it is a function, not a shim).
3. `block.rs`: add `render_with_children` as described; the block's own node (from `accessibility_nodes`) becomes the scope node. Keep the existing `render` for callers that draw children themselves (they get a flat tree; document this on `render`).
4. `spinner.rs`, `progress.rs`: set `LiveRegion::Polite` on their nodes (check `node.rs:160 LiveRegion` variants) and a `busy` state on the spinner; `input.rs`: `focused` state from the widget's focus flag; `tabs.rs`: selected tab node gets `selected`; `list.rs`/`table.rs`: selected row node gets `selected` and the container `set_focused` is the runtime's job (see `g09-impl-runtime`, which reads the focus manager).
5. Follow-up containers not done here (record in the close reason as follow-up beads under the epic): `Modal` stack, `Tabs` content area, `Pane` workspace adapters.
6. Gates and `ubs`; run `cargo test -p ftui-widgets` (existing paragraph a11y tests must still pass).

What NOT to do: do not change what `accessibility_nodes` returns beyond ids/states named above (their unit tests exist); do not add a11y to widgets that do not implement `Accessible` (follow-up); do not allocate when `a11y` is disabled (the `a11y_enabled()` check comes before the `Vec` is built).

## Files to change

- `crates/ftui-widgets/src/lib.rs`: `push_accessibility_nodes` helper.
- `crates/ftui-widgets/src/{block,tabs,progress,input,list,table,spinner,scrollbar,paragraph}.rs`: push in `render`; id/state fixes; `Block::render_with_children`.

## Success criteria

- [ ] For each of the nine widgets, a unit test `<widget>_render_pushes_a11y_nodes` renders into a `Frame` with a builder and asserts the built tree contains a node with the widget's role at the render area.
- [ ] `block_render_with_children_nests_child_nodes`: a `Block` with a `Paragraph` child rendered through `render_with_children` yields a tree where the paragraph node's parent is the block node.
- [ ] `render_without_builder_allocates_nothing`: rendering all nine widgets with `frame.a11y == None` performs no `accessibility_nodes` call (assert via a counting test double implemented as a wrapper widget in the test module; the no-mock policy in `ci.yml:63-71` bans the words mock/fake/stub in identifiers, so name it `CountingAccessible`).
- [ ] Existing snapshots in `crates/ftui-demo-showcase/tests/snapshots` unchanged (pushing nodes draws nothing): `cargo test -p ftui-demo-showcase --test screen_snapshots` green without re-blessing.

## Tests and logging

- Unit: the eleven tests above in the respective files' `#[cfg(test)]` modules.
- Logging: none in widgets.

## Dependencies and ordering

- Blocked by: `g09-impl` (`push_a11y`, `with_a11y_scope`, `stable_id_for`).
- Unblocks: `g09-impl-showcase`, `g09-tests`, `g09-e2e`.

## Considerations, risks, alternatives rejected

- Alternative rejected: a blanket `impl<W: Accessible> Widget for W` shim that pushes nodes automatically; Rust coherence forbids it for foreign types and it would hide the call site.
- Risk: ids derived from `(role, area)` change when the layout shifts, producing remove+add diffs and spurious announcements; the runtime's announcement policy (`ScreenReaderPolicy`, `tree.rs:440`) filters those to focus/live-region changes, so the noise is confined to the raw diff.

All nine widgets push nodes; `Block::render_with_children` exists and is used by at least the paragraph-in-block unit test; tests green; showcase snapshots unchanged; gates and `ubs` clean; close reason lists the eleven test names.

title: task(G09): ProgramConfig::with_accessibility, per-frame build/diff, a11y_announcement evidence, model hook
description:
## Context and why this matters

With `Frame` collecting nodes (`g09-impl`) and widgets pushing them (`g09-impl-widgets`), the runtime is what turns per-frame declarations into an accessibility tree that persists, diffs, and announces. README.md:2290-2300 promises "Live regions for announcing dynamic content changes to screen readers" and a panel that "visualizes the a11y tree in real time"; vision row V46 is DEAD because `Program` (`crates/ftui-runtime/src/program.rs`) has no a11y state at all (`rg -n 'a11y|A11y' program.rs` is empty). This bead adds the opt-in config, the per-frame build/diff, the `a11y_announcement` evidence event, and a model hook so apps (and the showcase panel) can read the tree without a new message type. Serves V46, V51 (evidence categories), Section 2.2.B.

## Current state (evidence)

- `program.rs`: `pub trait Model: Sized` :128 with default methods `subscriptions`, `on_shutdown`, `on_error` (so adding a default method is backward compatible); `ProgramConfig` field block around `:2940-3013` (`conformal_config` :2940, `resize_coalescer` :2948, `inline_auto_remeasure` :2966; defaults `:3006-3013`); builder methods around `:3140-3190` (`with_conformal_config` :3143, `without_conformal` :3151, `with_resize_coalescer` :3185); `Program` struct fields around `:4699-4790` (`writer` :4699, `widget_signals: Vec<WidgetSignal>` :4721, `conformal_predictor` :4745, `resize_coalescer`, `evidence_sink: Option<EvidenceSink>`, `guardrails` :4788); constructors build fields at `:4882-4940` (crossterm), `:5025-5073` (event-source), `:11317-11364` (headless test constructor `headless_program_with_resolved_config` :11276); `render_frame` :6113 with `frame.take_widget_signals()` at `:6582` and evidence writes such as `guardrail_snapshot` at `:6136` (`format!(r#"{{"schema_version":"{}","event":"guardrail_snapshot","snapshot":{}}}"#, ...)` then `sink.write_jsonl`).
- Evidence sink: `crates/ftui-runtime/src/evidence_sink.rs` `EvidenceSink::write_jsonl(&self, line: &str)` :200, `from_config` :161; `EvidenceSinkConfig::enabled_file` :90. The showcase enables the sink when `FTUI_DEMO_EVIDENCE_JSONL` is set (`crates/ftui-demo-showcase/src/main.rs:219-229`).
- Focus: the runtime does not own a focus manager (focus lives in `ftui-widgets` `focus/manager.rs`, Section 2.2.C row "Focus management"); the tree's `focused` id must come from widgets' `focused` states (a node with `A11yState.focused == true`) rather than from the runtime.
- `crates/ftui-a11y/src/tree.rs`: `A11yTree::diff` :290 -> `A11yTreeDiff` :341 (`added`, `removed`, `changed`, `focus_changed`); `ScreenReaderPolicy` :440, `ScreenReaderMirror` :461, `ScreenReaderAnnouncements` :478, `ScreenReaderAnnouncement` :487, `AnnouncementReason` :500 (the crate already has an announcement policy; read `tree.rs:440-520` for its API and reuse it rather than inventing rules).
- `telemetry_schema.rs` has no `TARGET_A11Y`; existing targets `:35-53`.
- G20 (cluster D, `g20-impl`) owns the canonical evidence event list, the JSON schema per event in `docs/spec/telemetry-events.md` (exists, 16 KB) and `tests/e2e/lib/e2e_jsonl_schema.json`, and the rule that tracing targets use `telemetry_schema` constants; `a11y_announcement` and `ftui.a11y` must be registered there.

## Target state

`ProgramConfig { accessibility: bool }` (default `false`) with `with_accessibility(bool)`; `Program` owns `a11y_builder: Option<A11yTreeBuilder>`, `a11y_order: Vec<u64>`, `last_a11y_tree: Option<Arc<A11yTree>>`, `a11y_mirror: ScreenReaderMirror` (or whatever `tree.rs:461` provides for announcement state). In `render_frame`, when enabled: reset the builder (`A11yTreeBuilder::with_capacity(last_len)`), set `frame.a11y = Some(&mut builder)` before `model.view(&mut frame)`, after view call `frame.finish_a11y()` and `take_a11y_order()`, `build()` the tree, set `focused` from the node with `focused == true`, diff against `last_a11y_tree`, run the announcement policy over the diff, write one `a11y_announcement` evidence line per announcement, store the new tree as `Arc`, and call `model.on_accessibility_tree(&tree)`. `Model::on_accessibility_tree(&mut self, _tree: &Arc<A11yTree>)` is a default no-op. Headless/simulator constructors honor the flag (tests use them).

## Implementation plan

1. `program.rs` `ProgramConfig`: add `pub accessibility: bool` (doc: "Build and diff an accessibility tree every frame; emits `a11y_announcement` evidence. Default false."), default `false` at the defaults block, builder `with_accessibility(mut self, enabled: bool) -> Self` next to `with_conformal_config`.
2. `Program` fields + initialization in all three constructors (`:4882`, `:5025`, `:11317` regions): `a11y_builder: config.accessibility.then(A11yTreeBuilder::new)`, `last_a11y_tree: None`, `a11y_mirror: ScreenReaderMirror::new(ScreenReaderPolicy::default())` (exact constructor per `tree.rs:440-478`).
3. `render_frame` (:6113): after the `Frame` is constructed and before `view`, `if let Some(b) = self.a11y_builder.as_mut() { frame.a11y = Some(b); }`; after `view` and `take_widget_signals` (:6582): the build/diff/announce sequence above. The builder is moved out via `std::mem::take` (implement `Default` on `A11yTreeBuilder`, already present at `tree.rs:31-35`) to satisfy the borrow checker, then re-created for the next frame.
4. Evidence line format (register with `g20-impl`): `{"schema_version":"<sink>","event":"a11y_announcement","frame_idx":N,"reason":"focus_changed|live_region|added|removed","node_id":u64,"role":"<A11yRole as_str>","name":"<escaped>","live":"polite|assertive|off","text":"<announcement text from ScreenReaderAnnouncement>"}` written through `self.evidence_sink` with the existing `json_escape` helper used by `resize_coalescer.rs` (`:479`). Also `tracing::debug!(target: telemetry_schema::TARGET_A11Y, ...)` for each announcement (feature `tracing`).
5. `telemetry_schema.rs`: `pub const TARGET_A11Y: &str = "ftui.a11y";` after `TARGET_EPROCESS` :53.
6. `Model` trait (:128): add `fn on_accessibility_tree(&mut self, _tree: &std::sync::Arc<ftui_a11y::A11yTree>) {}` with docs; `ftui-runtime` must depend on `ftui-a11y` (add to `crates/ftui-runtime/Cargo.toml`; it already reaches it transitively through ftui-widgets/ftui-render but needs the direct path for the type).
7. `Program::last_accessibility_tree(&self) -> Option<&Arc<A11yTree>>` accessor for tests and the harness `ProgramSimulator` (add a pass-through in `simulator.rs` if the simulator wraps `Program`; check `crates/ftui-runtime/src/simulator.rs`).
8. Gates and `ubs`.

What NOT to do: no new `Msg` variant for tree updates (the hook keeps `Model` backward compatible and message-type independent); no always-on building; no separate a11y thread; no string literal `"ftui.a11y"` outside `telemetry_schema.rs` (G20 rule).

## Files to change

- `crates/ftui-runtime/Cargo.toml`: `ftui-a11y` dependency.
- `crates/ftui-runtime/src/program.rs`: config field + builder, `Program` fields, constructors, `render_frame`, `Model::on_accessibility_tree`, accessor.
- `crates/ftui-runtime/src/telemetry_schema.rs`: `TARGET_A11Y`.
- `crates/ftui-runtime/src/simulator.rs`: accessor pass-through if applicable.
- `crates/ftui-runtime/src/lib.rs`: re-export `A11yTree` for consumers (`pub use ftui_a11y::A11yTree` in the prelude-like block near `:126`).

## Success criteria

- [ ] Headless test `accessibility_tree_is_built_when_enabled`: a model whose `view` renders a `Block` with two `TextInput`s; after one `run_pending`-style frame, `last_accessibility_tree()` has 3 nodes.
- [ ] `accessibility_tree_is_none_when_disabled`: same model, default config, `last_accessibility_tree()` is `None` and no builder allocation happens (assert `frame.a11y_enabled()` false via a model that records it).
- [ ] `focus_move_between_two_inputs_emits_one_announcement`: two frames with focus toggled produce exactly one `a11y_announcement` line with `reason":"focus_changed"` and the second input's name in a temp evidence file (pattern from `headless_render_frame_emits_guardrail_snapshot_evidence_on_alert` at `program.rs:12175`).
- [ ] `on_accessibility_tree_hook_receives_arc`: a model counts hook calls == frames rendered.
- [ ] `cargo test -p ftui-runtime --lib` green; no `"ftui.a11y"` literal outside `telemetry_schema.rs` (`rg -n '"ftui\.a11y"' crates --glob '!telemetry_schema.rs'` empty).

## Tests and logging

- Unit/headless: the four tests above in `program.rs` tests module using `headless_program_with_resolved_config`.
- Logging: evidence `a11y_announcement` (fields above); tracing `ftui.a11y` debug per announcement and `trace` per frame with `nodes`, `added`, `removed`, `changed` counts.

## Dependencies and ordering

- Blocked by: `g09-impl` (Frame hooks), `g09-impl-widgets` (nodes exist to build from; the tests use `TextInput`/`Block`), `g20-impl` (event name registration, schema, and the "no target literals" rule; if `g20-impl` lands later, register the event there when it does and keep this bead's line format as the source).
- Unblocks: `g09-impl-showcase`, `g09-tests`, `g09-e2e`, `g09-docs`.

## Considerations, risks, alternatives rejected

- Focus source: deriving `focused` from node states keeps the runtime independent of the widgets' focus manager; if two nodes claim focus in one frame, the first in render order wins and a `tracing::warn!` is emitted (documented).
- Announcement policy reuse: `ScreenReaderPolicy`/`ScreenReaderMirror` already encode debouncing rules (per `tree.rs:440-520`); using them avoids a second policy and gives the E2E scripts (`screen_reader_mirror_policy_tests` step in `scripts/a11y_transitions_e2e.sh`) a single behavior to assert.
- Cost: one map build + diff per frame when enabled; the showcase turns it on, so G25's `frame_render` row measures it; if it exceeds 5% of the 80x24 budget, gate the diff to every N-th frame behind a config knob (follow-up, not here).
- Rollback: `with_accessibility(false)`.

## Definition of done

Config, per-frame build/diff, evidence, hook, accessor implemented; four headless tests green; target constant added and used; gates and `ubs` clean; close reason lists test names and one sample evidence line.

Test headless_accessibility_builds_tree_and_exports_announcements passes; PTY E2E step pty_focus_announcements passes with focus_changed=1

title: feature(G09): accessibility_panel renders the real tree; showcase enables accessibility; dashboard snapshot
description:
## Context and why this matters

README.md:2300: "The `accessibility_panel` demo screen visualizes the a11y tree in real time as you navigate the UI." Today the screen (`crates/ftui-demo-showcase/src/screens/accessibility_panel.rs`, 571 lines) shows theme toggles (high contrast, large text, reduced motion) and an a11y telemetry event list; no tree is visible anywhere because none is built. After `g09-impl-runtime` the showcase can enable the tree and receive it through `Model::on_accessibility_tree`; this bead renders it in the panel so the README sentence becomes true and the snapshot `dashboard_a11y_tree_80x24.snap` has a real source. Serves V46 and the showcase's role as the reference app.

## Current state (evidence)

- `accessibility_panel.rs`: imports `crate::app::{A11yEventKind, A11yTelemetryEvent}` :25 and `crate::theme` :26; state `a11y: theme::A11ySettings` :41, `base_theme: theme::ThemeId` :42, `events: VecDeque<A11yEventEntry>` :43, `layout_toggles: Cell<Rect>` :44; header doc :3 "Accessibility Control Panel — demonstrates a11y modes and contrast checks".
- Snapshots: `accessibility_panel_initial_80x24.snap`, `a11y_accessibility_panel_all_modes_120x40.snap`, `a11y_accessibility_panel_{high_contrast,large_text,reduced_motion}_80x24.snap`.
- Showcase model: `crates/ftui-demo-showcase/src/app.rs` implements `Model` (screen ids at `:679`, `SnapshotPlayer => "TimeTravelStudio"` at `:839`); `main.rs` builds `ProgramConfig` at `:65-71`, `:110-115`, `:166-170` and `run_program` at `:186`; `apply_evidence_config` :219-229 enables the evidence sink from `FTUI_DEMO_EVIDENCE_JSONL`.
- `ftui-demo-showcase/Cargo.toml` does not depend on ftui-a11y directly (ftui-widgets does at `:27`); `A11yTree::dump_text(order)` will exist from `g09-impl`.
- Tests: `tests/a11y_snapshots.rs` (a11y_transition cases), `tests/a11y_modes_ux_a11y.rs`, `tests/screen_snapshots.rs`.

## Target state

The showcase enables `with_accessibility(true)` in every `ProgramConfig` it builds; `App::on_accessibility_tree` stores the `Arc<A11yTree>` (plus the render order, which the runtime passes alongside or embeds via `A11yTree::order()` added in `g09-impl` if `dump_text` needs it) in the model; the `accessibility_panel` screen gains a third pane "Tree" (left: toggles as today; middle: tree; right: events) showing `dump_text` lines with the focused node highlighted, scrollable with Up/Down/PageUp/PageDown, and a header line `nodes=<n> focused=<id or ->`. When the tree is `None` (accessibility disabled) the pane prints "accessibility tree disabled (ProgramConfig::with_accessibility)". The dashboard screen at 80x24 produces the snapshot `dashboard_a11y_tree_80x24.snap` (tree dump text, not the panel) via a test that renders the dashboard into a frame with a builder and dumps the tree.

## Implementation plan

1. `crates/ftui-demo-showcase/Cargo.toml`: add `ftui-a11y = { path = "../ftui-a11y", version = "0.6.0" }` (needed for the `A11yTree` type in `app.rs`).
2. `main.rs`: in each `ProgramConfig { .. }` literal (:65, :110, :166) set `accessibility: true` (or chain `.with_accessibility(true)` in `run_program` before running; one place is better: do it in `run_program` :186).
3. `app.rs`: add `a11y_tree: Option<Arc<A11yTree>>` to `App`; implement `fn on_accessibility_tree(&mut self, tree: &Arc<A11yTree>) { self.a11y_tree = Some(Arc::clone(tree)); }`; pass a reference into the `accessibility_panel` screen's view (screens receive `&App` context or a screen-specific state; follow the pattern used for `A11yTelemetryEvent` delivery to the panel).
4. `accessibility_panel.rs`: add `tree_scroll: usize`; split the content area into three columns with `Flex`; render the tree column with `Paragraph` lines from `tree.dump_text(order)` (one node per line, truncated to the column width, focused node line styled with the selection style); key handling for scroll; keep all toggle behavior and the events column unchanged so existing snapshots only change by the new column (re-bless with `BLESS=1` and review the diff: toggles must still be present).
5. `tests/screen_snapshots.rs`: add `dashboard_a11y_tree_80x24` (render the Dashboard screen into an 80x24 `Frame` whose `a11y` is a builder; `finish_a11y`; build; `dump_text(order)`; `insta::assert_snapshot!`), and `accessibility_panel_tree_80x24` (panel with a small tree injected).
6. Re-bless `accessibility_panel_initial_80x24` and the four `a11y_accessibility_panel_*` snapshots; check `tests/a11y_snapshots.rs` `a11y_transition` cases still pass (they exercise toggles).
7. Gates and `ubs`.

What NOT to do: do not remove the toggles or the events list; do not build a second tree in the showcase (the runtime builds it); no README edits (`g09-docs`).

## Files to change

- `crates/ftui-demo-showcase/Cargo.toml`: ftui-a11y dependency.
- `crates/ftui-demo-showcase/src/main.rs`: `with_accessibility(true)`.
- `crates/ftui-demo-showcase/src/app.rs`: `a11y_tree` field + hook.
- `crates/ftui-demo-showcase/src/screens/accessibility_panel.rs`: tree column, scroll, header.
- `crates/ftui-demo-showcase/tests/screen_snapshots.rs` + `tests/snapshots/*.snap`: two new snapshots, five re-blessed.

## Success criteria

- [ ] `dashboard_a11y_tree_80x24.snap` exists and lists at least the dashboard's `Block`s and any `Table`/`List`/`ProgressBar` nodes with roles and names (review the blessed content: it must not be empty or a single root).
- [ ] `accessibility_panel_tree_80x24.snap` shows the header `nodes=` and indented lines.
- [ ] Running the showcase under a PTY with `FTUI_DEMO_SCREEN=<accessibility_panel index>` for 2 s and pressing Tab shows a changed focused line (verified by `g09-e2e`).
- [ ] All existing showcase tests green after re-bless; `scripts/a11y_transitions_e2e.sh --quick` passes.

## Tests and logging

- Snapshot: the two new cases and five re-blessed.
- Unit (`accessibility_panel.rs`): `tree_column_scrolls_and_clamps` (30-line tree, 10-line viewport, PageDown twice clamps at 20), `disabled_tree_shows_hint`.
- Logging: showcase tracing `ftui.demo.a11y` debug on hook receipt with `nodes`, `focused`.

## Dependencies and ordering

- Blocked by: `g09-impl-runtime` (hook and config), `g09-impl-widgets` (dashboard widgets push nodes, otherwise the dashboard tree is empty).
- Unblocks: `g09-e2e`, `g09-tests` (snapshot names), `g09-docs`.

## Considerations, risks, alternatives rejected

- Alternative rejected: a new screen for the tree; the README names `accessibility_panel`, so the tree belongs there and the screen count stays 45 (G06 ledger).
- Risk: the dashboard tree dump depends on layout at 80x24; the snapshot pins it, which is the intent (any widget losing its a11y push shows as a snapshot diff).
- The panel reads the last frame's tree, so it lags one frame; acceptable and documented in the header line.

## Definition of done

Panel renders the tree; snapshots blessed; tests green; gates and `ubs` clean; close reason names the snapshot files and confirms the toggles still render.

title: task(G09): Frame collection, per-widget push, diff/announcement headless tests, proptests, tree snapshots
description:
## Context

Companion test bead for `g09-impl` (Frame hooks), `g09-impl-widgets` (nine widgets + Block scoping), `g09-impl-runtime` (per-frame build/diff/announce), and `g09-impl-showcase` (panel + dashboard dump). The README claims "semantic nodes for every interactive widget", "live regions for announcing dynamic content changes", and a real-time panel; the proofs are: render-order and nesting unit tests on `Frame`, per-widget push tests, headless diff/announcement tests through the evidence sink, and snapshots of the dashboard tree dump. No speed claim; a frame-time guard is delegated to G25's `frame_render` row with accessibility on in the showcase.

## What to test

1. Collection: nodes are collected in render order; scopes nest; no-op without a builder; ids unique per frame (debug assert).
2. Widgets: each of the nine pushes the node(s) its `accessibility_nodes` returns; `Block::render_with_children` nests; disabled path allocates nothing.
3. Runtime: tree built only when enabled; diff on focus move yields one announcement; live-region text change (ProgressBar value) yields one polite announcement; unchanged frames yield none; hook called once per frame; evidence line format is valid JSON with the registered fields.
4. Showcase: dashboard tree dump snapshot; panel snapshot; scroll clamping.

## Test types (unit, property, bench, E2E) with names and assertions

Unit, ftui-render `frame.rs`:
- `push_a11y_collects_nodes_in_render_order_with_block_nesting` (3 nodes; children parent == scope id; order preserved).
- `push_a11y_is_noop_without_builder`.
- `nested_scopes_three_deep_record_ancestry` (depth computed from parent chain == 2 for the innermost).
- `finish_a11y_applies_pending_children_once`.
- `duplicate_ids_in_one_frame_debug_assert` (`#[should_panic]` under `debug_assertions`).

Unit, ftui-a11y `tree.rs`: `dump_text_indents_by_depth`, `node_mut_returns_inserted_node`, `diff_reports_focus_change_when_focused_state_flips`.

Unit, ftui-widgets: `block_render_pushes_a11y_nodes`, `tabs_render_pushes_a11y_nodes`, `progress_render_pushes_a11y_nodes` (asserts `LiveRegion::Polite`), `input_render_pushes_a11y_nodes` (asserts `focused` state mirrors the widget), `list_render_pushes_a11y_nodes`, `table_render_pushes_a11y_nodes`, `spinner_render_pushes_a11y_nodes` (busy state), `scrollbar_render_pushes_a11y_nodes`, `paragraph_render_pushes_a11y_nodes`, `block_render_with_children_nests_child_nodes`, `render_without_builder_allocates_nothing` (uses a `CountingAccessible` wrapper; the CI no-mock policy at `.github/workflows/ci.yml:63-71` rejects identifiers containing mock/fake/stub, so keep that name).

Headless, ftui-runtime `program.rs` tests (pattern: `headless_program_with_resolved_config` :11276 + temp evidence file as in `headless_render_frame_emits_guardrail_snapshot_evidence_on_alert` :12175):
- `accessibility_tree_is_built_when_enabled` (3 nodes for Block + 2 TextInputs).
- `accessibility_tree_is_none_when_disabled`.
- `focus_move_between_two_inputs_emits_one_announcement` (exactly one `"event":"a11y_announcement"` with `"reason":"focus_changed"` and the target name).
- `progress_value_change_emits_polite_live_region_announcement`.
- `unchanged_frame_emits_no_announcement` (two identical frames -> zero lines).
- `on_accessibility_tree_hook_receives_arc` (hook count == frames).
- `a11y_announcement_line_is_valid_json_with_registered_fields` (parse with `serde_json` in tests; assert keys `event, frame_idx, reason, node_id, role, name, live, text`).

Snapshot, showcase: `dashboard_a11y_tree_80x24`, `accessibility_panel_tree_80x24`, re-blessed `accessibility_panel_initial_80x24` and `a11y_accessibility_panel_*`.

Property (ftui-a11y, `proptest`): `proptest_tree_diff_is_symmetric_on_swap` (for random trees A, B: `A.diff(&B).added == B.diff(&A).removed` as sets) and `proptest_diff_of_identical_tree_is_empty`.

Bench: none new; G25 `frame_render` row must stay within threshold with accessibility enabled in the showcase (note in close reason).

E2E: `g09-e2e`.

## Logging (structured JSONL fields, tracing targets)

- Evidence event `a11y_announcement`: `schema_version`, `event`, `frame_idx`, `reason`, `node_id`, `role`, `name`, `live`, `text`.
- Tracing target `ftui.a11y` (`telemetry_schema::TARGET_A11Y`): per-frame `trace` with `nodes`, `added`, `removed`, `changed`, `focus_changed`; per-announcement `debug`.
- Headless tests write the evidence file under the scratch dir returned by the existing `temp_evidence_path` helper (`program.rs:12201`) and print the file content on assertion failure.
- Snapshot tests: insta diffs.

## Files

- `crates/ftui-render/src/frame.rs`, `crates/ftui-a11y/src/tree.rs` (+ `tests/a11y_tests.rs` for the proptests; `proptest` dev-dep if missing), nine widget files, `crates/ftui-runtime/src/program.rs` tests module, `crates/ftui-demo-showcase/tests/screen_snapshots.rs`, `tests/snapshots/`.

## Success criteria

- [ ] All 30 named tests exist and pass (`rch exec -- cargo test -p ftui-render -p ftui-a11y -p ftui-widgets -p ftui-runtime -p ftui-demo-showcase`).
- [ ] Two proptests at 512 cases each pass.
- [ ] Snapshots committed; `dashboard_a11y_tree_80x24.snap` has more than 5 lines.
- [ ] `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings` green (tests included).

## Dependencies

- Blocked by: `g09-impl`, `g09-impl-widgets`, `g09-impl-runtime`, `g09-impl-showcase`.
- Unblocks: `g09-e2e`, `g09-docs`, epic closure.

## Definition of done

title: task(G09): Extend scripts/a11y_transitions_e2e.sh with PTY focus-announcement and panel-tree scenarios
description:
## Context and why this matters

Unit and headless tests prove the tree and announcements in isolation; the README promise is about a running program under a real terminal. The existing `scripts/a11y_transitions_e2e.sh` (exists, bd-2o55.2) runs the showcase's a11y snapshot tests with JSONL logging but does not drive a PTY or check announcements. This bead extends it with a PTY scenario: run the showcase's forms screen with the evidence sink enabled, press Tab several times, and assert that `a11y_announcement` lines with `focus_changed` reasons appear in order, with structured JSONL for diagnosis. It also gives G04.9 (PTY E2E failures) a named a11y case. Serves V46 and the reality check's convention that every block carries a PTY-backed proof with `tests/e2e/lib/pty.sh`.

## Current state (evidence)

- `scripts/a11y_transitions_e2e.sh`: sources `tests/e2e/lib/common.sh` and `logging.sh`; `e2e_fixture_init "a11y_transitions"`; `LOG_DIR` default `/tmp/ftui-a11y-transitions-<run>-<ts>`; `E2E_JSONL_FILE`, `E2E_CHILD_JSONL_DIR`; `run_step` wraps commands with `jsonl_step_start`/`jsonl_step_end` and per-step logs; steps `cargo_check`, `cargo_clippy` (skipped with `--quick`), `a11y_transition_tests` (`cargo test -p ftui-demo-showcase --test a11y_snapshots -- a11y_transition --nocapture` with `E2E_JSONL=1`), `screen_reader_mirror_policy_tests`.
- `tests/e2e/lib/pty.sh` (17 KB): the Python-`pty` driver used by `tests/e2e/scripts/*.sh`; `tests/e2e/lib/validate_jsonl.py` validates run JSONL against `tests/e2e/lib/e2e_jsonl_schema.json` (events `run_start`, `run_end`, `step_start`, `step_end`, `case_step_start`, `case_step_end`, `assert` rows via `jsonl_assert`).
- Showcase evidence: `FTUI_DEMO_EVIDENCE_JSONL=<path>` enables the sink (`crates/ftui-demo-showcase/src/main.rs:219-229`); `FTUI_DEMO_SCREEN=<n>` selects a screen and `FTUI_DEMO_EXIT_AFTER_MS` exits (both used at `scripts/demo_showcase_e2e.sh:2364`).
- Forms screen: `tests/e2e/scripts/test_form_validation.sh` and `crates/ftui-demo-showcase/tests/form_validation_e2e.rs` exist; the screen has multiple `TextInput`s (Tab moves focus).
- `tests/e2e/scripts/test_a11y_modes.sh` exists and writes `a11y_modes.jsonl` (mode toggles, not announcements).

## Target state

`scripts/a11y_transitions_e2e.sh` gains a step `a11y_focus_announcements_pty` that: builds the showcase (unless `--quick`), runs it under `tests/e2e/lib/pty.sh` at 80x24 with `FTUI_DEMO_SCREEN=<forms index>` (resolve the index from `crates/ftui-demo-showcase/src/screens/mod.rs` at script time by grepping the slug, not a hard-coded number), `FTUI_DEMO_EVIDENCE_JSONL=$LOG_DIR/a11y_evidence.jsonl`, `FTUI_DEMO_EXIT_AFTER_MS=2500`; sends Tab, Tab, Shift+Tab (`\t`, `\t`, `\x1b[Z`) with 300 ms gaps, then `q`; then asserts: exit code 0; at least 3 `a11y_announcement` lines with `"reason":"focus_changed"`; the `name` sequence is `[input2, input3, input2]` (names read from the screen's node names; assert the third equals the first); no `assertive` announcements; the evidence file validates as JSON per line. A second step `a11y_panel_shows_tree_pty` runs the `accessibility_panel` screen for 1.5 s and asserts the canonicalized screen (via `pty.sh`'s canonicalize helper used by `test_pty_canonicalize.sh`) contains `nodes=` and at least one line starting with two spaces followed by a role name.

## Implementation plan

1. In `scripts/a11y_transitions_e2e.sh`, after the existing steps, add `run_step "a11y_focus_announcements_pty" bash -c '...'` implementing the scenario with the `pty.sh` API (`e2e_pty_run` or whatever the helper exports; read `tests/e2e/lib/pty.sh:1-80` for the function names and the key-sequence file format before writing).
2. Assertions with `jsonl_assert` names: `a11y_pty_exit_code`, `a11y_announcements_count` (detail `count=<n>`), `a11y_focus_sequence` (detail `names=<a>,<b>,<c>`), `a11y_no_assertive`, `a11y_evidence_json_valid` (loop `python3 -c 'import json,sys; [json.loads(l) for l in sys.stdin]'`).
3. Add `a11y_panel_shows_tree_pty` similarly with `jsonl_assert` `a11y_panel_header_present`, `a11y_panel_tree_lines` (detail `lines=<n>`).
4. Ensure `scripts/a11y_transitions_e2e.sh` is invoked by CI: check `.github/workflows/ci.yml` `e2e-pty` job (`:528`) or the `demo-showcase` job (`:438`) for the current call sites; if absent, add it to `e2e-pty` after G04.6's tooling step (`rg` and python deps), with the run's `LOG_DIR` uploaded as an artifact `a11y-transitions-e2e`.
5. Add the two new case names to `tests/e2e/scripts/run_all.sh` if that runner enumerates cases (it lists `test_a11y_modes.sh`; the announcement case lives in `scripts/`, so document the split in the script header).

What NOT to do: no sleeps longer than needed (total under 10 s); no dependence on `rg` inside the script (use `grep -c`/python) until G04.6 lands; no hard-coded screen index.

## Files to change

- `scripts/a11y_transitions_e2e.sh`: two new steps.
- `.github/workflows/ci.yml`: invocation + artifact (if not already invoked).
- `tests/e2e/scripts/run_all.sh`: reference/documentation line if applicable.

## Success criteria

- [ ] Local run `scripts/a11y_transitions_e2e.sh --quick` prints `a11y_focus_announcements_pty PASS` and `a11y_panel_shows_tree_pty PASS`; `tests/e2e/lib/validate_jsonl.py $E2E_JSONL_FILE` exits 0.
- [ ] The evidence file from the run contains the three `focus_changed` lines; paste them into the close reason.
- [ ] CI job that runs the script is green on `main` (run id in the close reason).

## Tests and logging

- E2E JSONL (run-level, via `logging.sh`): `run_id`, `scenario` (`a11y_transitions`), `step_start`/`step_end` with `duration_ms` and `hash_key`, `assert` rows named above with `detail` strings; per-step logs under `$LOG_DIR/<step>.log`; PTY raw capture `$LOG_DIR/a11y_focus.pty` and canonicalized screen `$LOG_DIR/a11y_focus.screen`; evidence file `$LOG_DIR/a11y_evidence.jsonl`; exit code recorded in `a11y_pty_exit_code`.
- Escape-sequence tallies: reuse `pty.sh`'s counters (`1049h/l`, `2026h/l`, `?25l/h`) and log them in the step detail for diagnosis, as `scripts/consumer_smoke_e2e.sh` (G01) does.

## Dependencies and ordering

- Blocked by: `g09-impl-showcase` (panel + `with_accessibility(true)` in the showcase), `g09-impl-runtime` (announcements).
- Related: `g04-06-impl` (runner tooling) for CI; `g20-impl` (schema validation of `a11y_announcement` in `tests/e2e/lib/e2e_jsonl_schema.json` if G20 extends the schema to evidence events).

## Considerations, risks, alternatives rejected

- Timing: focus announcements are frame-driven; 300 ms between keys is 18 frames at 60 Hz, ample. If CI runners are slow, the assertion is on counts and order, not timing.
- Alternative rejected: asserting on screen text only; the announcement stream is the feature, so the evidence file is the primary assertion.

## Definition of done

Script extended, run locally with JSONL validated, CI invocation green; close reason includes the assert rows and the three evidence lines.

title: docs(G09): README Accessibility section, docs/ACCESSIBILITY.md runtime integration, telemetry spec row
description:
## Context and why this matters

README.md:2290-2300 "## Accessibility" and `docs/ACCESSIBILITY.md` ("Phase 2 complete") describe a tree that, before G09, was never built. After `g09-impl-*` the claims become true with specific preconditions (`ProgramConfig::with_accessibility(true)`, showcase on by default, evidence event `a11y_announcement`, tracing target `ftui.a11y`, model hook `on_accessibility_tree`). The docs must state those preconditions, the claims ledger (G06) needs a row with the proof names, and the telemetry spec (G20's `docs/spec/telemetry-events.md`) needs the new event's schema. This bead is the DOC half of V46.

## Current state (evidence)

- README.md:2290-2300: five bullets (semantic nodes, role/state/label, focus graph, live regions, contrast checking) and the panel sentence at :2300; `docs/ACCESSIBILITY.md` (8 KB) header "Current Status (Phase 2 complete)", describes `A11yRole` (23 variants), `A11yState`, `A11yNodeInfo`, and links tracking issue #44.
- `docs/spec/telemetry-events.md` (16 KB) has span tables per category (`ftui.program.init`, ...); no `a11y` entries.
- After G09: `Frame::push_a11y`/`with_a11y_scope`, `Block::render_with_children`, `ProgramConfig::with_accessibility`, `Model::on_accessibility_tree`, `Program::last_accessibility_tree`, `A11yTree::dump_text`, evidence `a11y_announcement`, `TARGET_A11Y`.

## Target state

A short `rust,no_run` example (doc-tested by G02's `ReadmeDoctests` include) shows a model implementing the hook. `docs/ACCESSIBILITY.md` gets a "Runtime integration (2026-09)" section with the same facts plus the widget list and the follow-ups (Modal, Tabs content, Pane containers). `docs/spec/telemetry-events.md` gets an "Accessibility events" table row for `a11y_announcement` with its fields. Claims-ledger row for V46.

## Implementation plan

1. README "## Accessibility": rewrite the five bullets to match the code; add "Enabling" and "Limitations" paragraphs; add the example:
   ```rust,no_run
   use std::sync::Arc;
   use ftui::prelude::*;
   use ftui_a11y::A11yTree;
   struct App;
   impl Model for App {
       type Message = ();
       fn update(&mut self, _m: ()) -> Cmd<()> { Cmd::none() }
       fn view(&self, frame: &mut Frame) { Paragraph::new("hi").render(frame.area_rect(), frame); }
       fn on_accessibility_tree(&mut self, tree: &Arc<A11yTree>) { let _ = tree.len(); }
   }
   fn main() -> std::io::Result<()> {
       App::new(App).config(ProgramConfig::default().with_accessibility(true)).run()
   }
   ```
   Adjust names to the real API (`App` builder from G01; `Frame` area accessor per G17.9 if it exists by then, else `Rect::new(0,0,frame.width(),frame.height())`), and confirm `ftui` re-exports `ftui_a11y` (add `pub use ftui_a11y as a11y;` to `crates/ftui/src/lib.rs` if not; that is a one-line facade change owned here).
2. `docs/ACCESSIBILITY.md`: new section; update "Current Status" wording from "Phase 2 complete" to the dated truth; list the nine widgets and the follow-up containers.
3. `docs/spec/telemetry-events.md`: add `a11y_announcement` row (fields `frame_idx, reason, node_id, role, name, live, text`) and the `ftui.a11y` target; coordinate with `g20-impl` so the JSON schema file gets the event too.
4. Claims-ledger row: `Accessibility tree built per frame, live-region announcements` / `README.md:Accessibility` / CODE / tests `accessibility_tree_is_built_when_enabled`, `focus_move_between_two_inputs_emits_one_announcement`, snapshot `dashboard_a11y_tree_80x24.snap`, E2E step `a11y_focus_announcements_pty` / DONE.

## Files to change

- `README.md`: Accessibility section.
- `docs/ACCESSIBILITY.md`: runtime integration section.
- `docs/spec/telemetry-events.md`: event row.
- `crates/ftui/src/lib.rs`: `pub use ftui_a11y as a11y;` if absent.
- `docs/claims-ledger.md` (if present): row.

## Success criteria

- [ ] `cargo test -p ftui --doc` compiles the README example (G02 infrastructure) or, if G02 has not landed, `cargo build --example a11y_hook` for a copy placed at `crates/ftui/examples/a11y_hook.rs`.
- [ ] README no longer claims an OS accessibility bridge; states the enabling call.
- [ ] `rg -n 'a11y_announcement' docs/spec/telemetry-events.md README.md docs/ACCESSIBILITY.md` hits all three.

## Tests and logging

- Doc-test of the README example; no other tests.

## Dependencies and ordering

- Blocked by: `g09-impl-runtime` (API names final), `g09-impl-showcase` (panel behavior to describe).
- Unblocks: `g06-impl` ledger row; `g20-impl` schema entry.

## Considerations, risks, alternatives rejected

- Keep the README section short; the detailed API belongs in `docs/ACCESSIBILITY.md` and rustdoc.

## Definition of done

Three documents updated; example compiles; ledger row recorded; close reason lists the README line range.

Claims-ledger row deferred to G06 .5.2 (ledger file does not exist yet). readme_accessibility_snippets compiled but not executed here (fleet down, disk full); README text match verified outside cargo.
