title: epic(G18): Wire GestureRecognizer and HoverStabilizer into widgets (DEAD -> WORKING)
description:
# epic(G18): Wire GestureRecognizer and HoverStabilizer into widgets (DEAD -> WORKING)

## Context and why this matters

The README sells two pieces of input intelligence that no shipping widget uses.

README.md:1043-1065 ("Gesture Recognition State Machine") says: "The `GestureRecognizer` in
`ftui-core` (2,100+ lines) transforms raw terminal events into semantic events via a
multi-phase state machine" and draws a diagram producing `Click`, `DoubleClick`,
`TripleClick (select word / line)`, `DragStart`, `DragMove`, `DragEnd`. It then states
"**Dead zone:** drag is only recognized after the pointer moves beyond a configurable
threshold (default: 2 cells)" and "**Multi-click timing:** double/triple clicks use a
configurable interval window (default: 500ms)".

README.md:1030-1041 ("CUSUM Hover Stabilizer (Mouse Jitter)") says hover target flicker is
suppressed with a CUSUM change-point detector, "single-cell jitter doesn't cause hover
flicker, but intentional crossings still switch within a couple frames". README.md:2182
(Table Theming table) says "Hover state | Mouse-over styling with CUSUM-stabilized
transitions".

Reality (2026-09-01 audit, commit `ab07291f`): both modules exist with unit tests but are
unreachable from any widget. This block closes vision rows V15 ("CUSUM allocation + hover":
DEAD / demo-only) and V60 ("Gesture recognizer": DEAD), plus the two Section 2.2.B rows for
`gesture.rs` and `hover_stabilizer.rs`. The user-visible consequence today: a `Table` row
highlight flickers when the pointer jitters on a row boundary, `TextArea` has no mouse
selection at all, and drag widgets use ad-hoc thresholds that do not match the documented
state machine. The README's stated defaults (2 cells, 500 ms) are also wrong; the G06
decision table marks "gesture defaults" as a DOC fix, so the README changes, not the code.

## Current state (evidence)

- `crates/ftui-core/src/gesture.rs` (2,125 lines): `GestureConfig` at :48, `impl Default`
  at :63-72 sets `multi_click_timeout: 300 ms`, `long_press_threshold: 500 ms`,
  `drag_threshold: 3`, `chord_timeout: 1000 ms`, `swipe_velocity_threshold: 50.0`,
  `click_tolerance: 1`. `GestureRecognizer` at :107, `new(config)` at :138,
  `process(&mut self, event: &Event, now: Instant) -> Vec<SemanticEvent>` at :156.
  `rg -l GestureRecognizer crates` returns only `gesture.rs`: zero callers.
- `crates/ftui-core/src/hover_stabilizer.rs` (1,061 lines): CUSUM description at :13-16
  (`S_t = max(0, S_{t-1} + d_t - k)`, switch when `S_t > h`). `HoverStabilizerConfig` at :46
  with defaults at :74-79 (`drift_allowance 0.5`, `detection_threshold 2.0`,
  `hysteresis_cells 1`, `decay_rate 0.1`, `hold_timeout 500 ms`). `HoverStabilizer` at :107,
  `new` at :129, `update(` at :152, `current_target() -> Option<u64>` at :217. Sole caller:
  `crates/ftui-demo-showcase/src/screens/mouse_playground.rs:35,589,633`.
- `crates/ftui-widgets/src/table.rs:604-614`: hover is a plain compare
  (`let changed = self.hovered != Some(index); self.hovered = Some(index); return if changed
  { MouseResult::HoverChanged } else { MouseResult::Ignored }`).
- `crates/ftui-widgets/src/list.rs`: `hover_style` field :81 and builder :140,
  `ListState.hovered: Option<usize>` :383, cleared at :229. No stabilizer.
- `crates/ftui-widgets/src/drag.rs`: `pub trait Draggable` :287, `pub trait DropTarget` :465,
  `DragPreviewConfig` :513, `DragPreview` :646. No recognizer.
- `crates/ftui-widgets/src/textarea.rs`: `handle_event(&mut self, event: &Event) -> bool`
  at :118 matches keys only; there is no `Event::Mouse` arm. `select_word_left/right` at
  :516/:522, `editor_mut()` at :403; `editor.rs` has `select_all` :732 and `select_word_*`
  :722-727.
- README defaults (2 cells / 500 ms) contradict the code (3 cells / 300 ms).

## Target state

- `Draggable`/`DropTarget` drive drag lifecycle from `GestureRecognizer` semantic events
  (dead zone = `drag_threshold`).
- `TextArea` handles mouse: click places the cursor, double-click selects the word,
  triple-click selects the line, all through `GestureRecognizer`.
- `Table` and `List` hover go through `HoverStabilizer`; one-cell jitter across a row
  boundary does not change the hovered row; an intentional crossing switches within a
  few frames.
- Apps tune thresholds through `ProgramConfig::with_gesture_config(GestureConfig)`.
- README states the real defaults (300 ms multi-click, 3-cell dead zone) and names the
  widgets that use the stabilizer (DOC rows in the G06 claims ledger).
- `mouse_playground` keeps its stabilizer demo.

## Success criteria

- [ ] Unit tests (g18-tests): `textarea_double_click_selects_word`,
      `textarea_triple_click_selects_line`, `drag_requires_dead_zone`,
      `table_hover_ignores_one_cell_jitter_across_row_boundary`,
      `table_hover_switches_on_intentional_move`, `list_hover_stabilized` all green.
- [ ] PTY E2E (g18-e2e) `tests/e2e/scripts/test_gestures.sh` runs the `MousePlayground`
      screen under `tests/e2e/lib/pty.sh`, injects SGR mouse sequences, and logs recognized
      gestures as JSONL validated by `tests/e2e/lib/validate_jsonl.py --strict`; green in the
      `e2e-pty` CI job (`.github/workflows/ci.yml:528`).
- [ ] README.md:1043-1065, :1030-1041, :2182 corrected (g18-docs) with claims-ledger rows.
- [ ] `scripts/check_module_reachability.py` (G07) no longer lists `gesture` or
      `hover_stabilizer` as orphans.

## Implementation plan

1. g18-impl: wire the recognizer into `drag.rs` and `textarea.rs`, the stabilizer into
   `table.rs` and `list.rs`, add `ProgramConfig::with_gesture_config`.
2. g18-tests: unit and property tests with explicit `Instant` arguments (no sleeping).
3. g18-e2e: PTY scenario with JSONL logging.
4. g18-docs: README and ledger.

## Dependencies and ordering

No block-level dependency (Section 7.5 lists G18 among day-one parallel tracks). Children
order: g18-impl -> g18-tests, g18-e2e, g18-docs (docs also needs the ledger file from
g06-impl-ledger). G07's reachability gate consumes the result.

## Considerations, risks, alternatives rejected

- Rejected: changing `GestureConfig` defaults to the README's numbers. The code defaults
  were chosen deliberately (300 ms matches common desktop double-click windows; a 3-cell dead
  zone avoids accidental drags on wide cells). G06 marks this row DOC.
- Rejected: a second, widget-local recognizer. One recognizer in `ftui-core` is the whole
  point; widgets consume `SemanticEvent`.
- Risk: `HoverStabilizer` adds a few frames of latency to intentional hover changes. The
  detection threshold 2.0 with drift 0.5 was tuned in `mouse_playground`; the jitter test
  and the intentional-move test bound both sides.
- Risk: `TextArea` mouse selection needs cell-to-grapheme mapping; reuse
  `CursorNavigator::from_visual_col` (`crates/ftui-text/src/cursor.rs:73`) so wide graphemes
  behave.
- Rollback: each widget change is independent; reverting one file restores the plain
  compare without affecting the others.

## Definition of done

All four children closed with test names and the E2E run id in their close reasons; the
recognizer and stabilizer are reachable from production widget code; README rows updated in
the claims ledger; `main` green.

title: feature(G18): Wire GestureRecognizer into drag/TextArea and HoverStabilizer into Table/List
description:
# feature(G18): Wire GestureRecognizer into drag/TextArea and HoverStabilizer into Table/List

## Context and why this matters

README.md:1043-1065 promises that `GestureRecognizer` in `ftui-core` turns raw mouse
events into `Click`, `DoubleClick`, `TripleClick (select word / line)`, `DragStart`,
`DragMove`, `DragEnd` with a dead zone and a multi-click window. README.md:1030-1041 and
:2182 promise that hover targets are CUSUM-stabilized so "single-cell jitter doesn't cause
hover flicker". Neither module has a production consumer. This bead makes both reachable
from widget code, closing vision rows V15 and V60 and the two Section 2.2.B rows. Users get
mouse selection in `TextArea`, a consistent drag dead zone, and flicker-free `Table`/`List`
hover.

## Current state (evidence)

- `crates/ftui-core/src/gesture.rs`: `GestureConfig` :48, defaults :63-72 (multi-click
  300 ms, long-press 500 ms, drag threshold 3 cells, chord 1000 ms, swipe velocity 50.0,
  click tolerance 1). `GestureRecognizer` :107, `new(config)` :138,
  `process(&mut self, event: &Event, now: Instant) -> Vec<SemanticEvent>` :156. No callers
  outside the file.
- `crates/ftui-core/src/hover_stabilizer.rs`: `HoverStabilizerConfig` :46 (defaults :74-79),
  `HoverStabilizer` :107, `new` :129, `update(` :152, `current_target() -> Option<u64>` :217.
  Only `mouse_playground.rs:35,589,633` uses it.
- `crates/ftui-widgets/src/table.rs:604-614`: plain compare sets `self.hovered` and returns
  `MouseResult::HoverChanged` on every change.
- `crates/ftui-widgets/src/list.rs`: `hover_style` :81/:140, `ListState.hovered` :383,
  cleared :229.
- `crates/ftui-widgets/src/drag.rs`: `Draggable` :287, `DropTarget` :465,
  `DragPreviewConfig` :513, `DragPreview` :646; `keyboard_drag.rs` `DropTargetInfo` :135.
- `crates/ftui-widgets/src/textarea.rs`: `handle_event` :118 has no `Event::Mouse` arm;
  `select_word_left/right` :516/:522; `editor_mut()` :403. `editor.rs`: `select_all` :732,
  `select_word_*` :722-727. `cursor.rs`: `CursorNavigator::from_visual_col` :73.
- `crates/ftui-core/src/event.rs`: `MouseEvent { kind, x: u16, y: u16, modifiers }` :264,
  `MouseEvent::new(kind, x, y)` :281, `MouseEventKind::{Down(MouseButton), Up, Drag, Moved,
  ScrollUp, ScrollDown, ScrollLeft, ScrollRight}` :306.
- `crates/ftui-runtime/src/program.rs`: `ProgramConfig` :2922; builder pattern examples
  `with_evidence_sink` :3122, `with_conformal_config` :3143, `with_resize_coalescer` :3185,
  `with_inline_auto_remeasure` :3238, `with_guardrails` :3259, `with_tick_strategy` :3282.

## Target state

- `Draggable`/`DropTarget` implementations and `DragPreview` receive drag lifecycle from
  `GestureRecognizer` semantic events; the dead zone is `GestureConfig::drag_threshold`.
- `TextArea::handle_event` handles `Event::Mouse`: single click moves the cursor,
  double-click selects the word under the pointer, triple-click selects the line, drag
  extends the selection.
- `Table` and `List` hover changes pass through `HoverStabilizer` keyed by row index.
- `ProgramConfig::with_gesture_config(GestureConfig)` exists; widgets receive the config
  through their own `with_gesture_config` builders (no thread-local).
- `mouse_playground` keeps its stabilizer demo unchanged.

## Implementation plan

1. `crates/ftui-core/src/gesture.rs`: no behavior change. Add `impl GestureConfig { pub fn
   with_drag_threshold(..), with_multi_click_timeout(..) }` builders if absent, and make
   `SemanticEvent` carry the originating cell coordinates so widgets do not re-derive them.
2. `crates/ftui-widgets/src/textarea.rs`: add `gesture: GestureRecognizer` and
   `gesture_config: GestureConfig` fields (default config); builder
   `with_gesture_config(GestureConfig)`. In `handle_event` add an `Event::Mouse(m)` arm that
   calls `self.gesture.process(event, Instant::now())` and maps: `Click` -> cursor to
   `CursorNavigator::from_visual_col(line, col)` (subtract line-number gutter and scroll
   anchor), `DoubleClick` -> `editor.select_word_left()` then `select_word_right()` from the
   click position (or a new `Editor::select_word_at(pos)` if the two-step produces wrong
   anchors), `TripleClick` -> new `Editor::select_line(line)`, `DragMove` -> extend selection
   head. Add `pub fn handle_mouse_at(&mut self, m: &MouseEvent, now: Instant)` so tests pass
   explicit times.
3. `crates/ftui-widgets/src/drag.rs`: give the drag controller a `GestureRecognizer`;
   `DragStart` is emitted only after `drag_threshold` cells of movement (dead zone),
   `DragMove` updates `DragPreview`, `DragEnd` resolves the `DropTarget`. Remove the ad-hoc
   threshold constants that this replaces (in place; no wrapper kept).
4. `crates/ftui-widgets/src/table.rs`: add `hover_stabilizer: HoverStabilizer` to the table
   state that owns `hovered`; replace :604-614 with
   `self.hover_stabilizer.update(Some(index as u64), boundary_distance, now)` followed by
   `let target = self.hover_stabilizer.current_target().map(|t| t as usize); let changed =
   target != self.hovered; self.hovered = target; MouseResult::HoverChanged` only when
   `changed`. Distance is the signed cell distance of `y` from the nearest row edge (row
   height from the theme's `row_height`). Add `with_hover_stabilizer_config`.
5. `crates/ftui-widgets/src/list.rs`: same for `ListState.hovered` (:383); clearing at :229
   also resets the stabilizer.
6. `crates/ftui-runtime/src/program.rs`: `ProgramConfig.gesture: GestureConfig` (default) and
   `with_gesture_config(GestureConfig)` following the :3122-3282 builder style; expose
   `Program::gesture_config()` so the app's `Model` can pass it into widget builders. No
   thread-local; no `Frame` change.
7. `crates/ftui-demo-showcase`: `advanced_text_editor` and `widget_gallery` pass the config
   through; `mouse_playground` unchanged.
8. Run `cargo check --workspace --all-targets`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D
   warnings`, `cargo fmt --check`, `ubs` on changed files.

What NOT to do: no second recognizer or hover heuristic inside widgets; do not change
`GestureConfig` defaults to match the README (G06 marks that row DOC); no compatibility
wrapper around the old compare path; no new file variants; no script-driven edits; no
deletion of any file.

## Files to change

- `crates/ftui-core/src/gesture.rs`: builders, coordinates on `SemanticEvent`.
- `crates/ftui-widgets/src/textarea.rs`: mouse arm, recognizer field, `handle_mouse_at`.
- `crates/ftui-widgets/src/drag.rs`: recognizer-driven drag lifecycle.
- `crates/ftui-widgets/src/table.rs`: stabilized hover at :604-614.
- `crates/ftui-widgets/src/list.rs`: stabilized hover.
- `crates/ftui-text/src/editor.rs`: `select_word_at`, `select_line`.
- `crates/ftui-runtime/src/program.rs`: `with_gesture_config`.
- `crates/ftui-demo-showcase/src/screens/{advanced_text_editor,widget_gallery}.rs`: pass config.

## Success criteria

- [ ] g18-tests green: `textarea_double_click_selects_word`,
      `textarea_triple_click_selects_line`, `textarea_click_moves_cursor_unicode`,
      `drag_requires_dead_zone`, `table_hover_ignores_one_cell_jitter_across_row_boundary`,
      `table_hover_switches_on_intentional_move`, `list_hover_stabilized`.
- [ ] `rg -l GestureRecognizer crates` lists `textarea.rs` and `drag.rs`; `rg -l
      HoverStabilizer crates` lists `table.rs` and `list.rs`.
- [ ] Existing snapshots for `widget_gallery` and `advanced_text_editor` unchanged (no
      render change when no mouse event occurs).
- [ ] g18-e2e scenario green in `e2e-pty`.

## Tests and logging

Unit tests in g18-tests use explicit `Instant` values passed to `process`/`update`. Add a
`tracing::debug!(target: "ftui.input.gesture", kind, x, y)` line per recognized gesture in
`textarea.rs` and `drag.rs`, and `target: "ftui.input.hover"` on stabilizer switches, so the
E2E script can count them when `FTUI_HARNESS_LOG_KEYS`-style logging is on. Targets are
added to `telemetry_schema.rs` by g20-impl-schema-constants; until then use the literal and
list it in that bead's inventory.

## Dependencies and ordering

Blocked by nothing. Unblocks g18-tests, g18-e2e, g18-docs. G07's reachability gate removes
`gesture` and `hover_stabilizer` from its allowlist once this lands.

## Considerations, risks, alternatives rejected

- Passing config through widget builders instead of a thread-local keeps widgets pure and
  testable; the cost is one extra builder call in the showcase.
- `HoverStabilizer` needs a distance signal; row-edge distance in cells is the simplest
  honest input and matches the module's normalized-distance contract (:46-53).
- If `select_word_left` then `select_word_right` yields the wrong anchor for a click in the
  middle of a word, add `Editor::select_word_at` rather than patching around it.
- Rollback: revert per file.

## Definition of done

# task(G18): Double/triple-click selection tests and Table hover jitter test

## Context

g18-impl wires `GestureRecognizer` (`crates/ftui-core/src/gesture.rs`, defaults at :63-72:
multi-click 300 ms, drag threshold 3 cells) into `TextArea` and the drag widgets, and
`HoverStabilizer` (`crates/ftui-core/src/hover_stabilizer.rs`, defaults :74-79: drift 0.5,
threshold 2.0, hysteresis 1 cell, hold 500 ms) into `Table` and `List`. README.md:1041
claims "single-cell jitter doesn't cause hover flicker, but intentional crossings still
switch within a couple frames"; README.md:1050-1052 claims `TripleClick (select word /
line)`. These tests are the proof behind those sentences. All timing goes through explicit
`Instant` arguments (`process(event, now)` at gesture.rs:156, `update(.., now)` at
hover_stabilizer.rs:152); no test sleeps.

## What to test

- TextArea mouse selection: click, double-click word, triple-click line, Unicode widths.
- Drag dead zone: movement under `drag_threshold` never starts a drag; at or beyond it does.
- Table hover: one-cell jitter across a row boundary keeps the hovered row; a sustained
  move switches within three frames.
- List hover: same stabilization contract.
- Property: the stabilized hover target is always `None` or a valid row index.

## Test types (unit, property, bench, E2E) with names and assertions

Unit (`crates/ftui-widgets/src/textarea.rs` `#[cfg(test)]`):
- `textarea_click_moves_cursor_unicode`: text `"héllo wörld"`, click at visual column 7
  (after the wide-aware mapping via `CursorNavigator::from_visual_col`, cursor.rs:73);
  assert `editor().cursor().grapheme == 7`.
- `textarea_double_click_selects_word`: text `"alpha beta gamma"`, two `Down(Left)`/`Up`
  pairs at column 8 with `now` and `now + 100 ms`; assert `selected_text() == Some("beta")`.
- `textarea_double_click_too_slow_is_two_clicks`: same with `now + 400 ms` (over the
  300 ms window); assert `selection().is_none()` and cursor at column 8.
- `textarea_triple_click_selects_line`: three clicks 80 ms apart on line 1 of a 3-line
  buffer; assert selection anchor at line start and head at line end (trailing newline
  excluded).
- `textarea_drag_extends_selection`: `Down` at col 2, `Drag` to col 9 (beyond the 3-cell
  dead zone), `Up`; assert `selected_text()` covers cols 2..9.

Unit (`crates/ftui-widgets/src/drag.rs`):
- `drag_requires_dead_zone`: `Down` at (5,5), `Drag` to (7,5) yields no `DragStart`
  (2 cells < threshold 3); `Drag` to (8,5) yields `DragStart`; `Up` yields `DragEnd`.
- `drag_threshold_is_configurable`: `GestureConfig { drag_threshold: 1, ..Default }` starts
  the drag at (6,5).

Unit (`crates/ftui-widgets/src/table.rs`):
- `table_hover_ignores_one_cell_jitter_across_row_boundary`: 5 rows, row height 1, pointer
  alternates `y = 3, 4, 3, 4, 3, 4` at 16 ms intervals; assert `hovered == Some(3)` after
  every frame and that `MouseResult::HoverChanged` was returned at most once (the initial
  entry).
- `table_hover_switches_on_intentional_move`: pointer at `y = 3` for two frames then
  `y = 4` for three consecutive frames; assert `hovered == Some(4)` by the third frame.
- `table_hover_clears_on_leave`: pointer leaves the table area; assert `hovered == None`
  after `hold_timeout` (500 ms) elapses in virtual time.

Unit (`crates/ftui-widgets/src/list.rs`):
- `list_hover_stabilized`: same jitter sequence as the table test on `ListState.hovered`.

Property (proptest, `crates/ftui-widgets/tests/proptest_hover.rs` or inline):
- `hover_target_is_none_or_valid_index`: arbitrary sequences of `MouseEventKind::Moved` at
  arbitrary `(x, y)` inside and outside a 10-row table; after each event the stabilized
  target is `None` or `< 10`.
- `hover_switch_count_bounded_by_crossings`: number of `HoverChanged` results is at most the
  number of sustained crossings (three consecutive frames on a new row) plus one.

Bench: none (no speed claim in this block).

E2E: covered by g18-e2e (`tests/e2e/scripts/test_gestures.sh`).

## Logging (structured JSONL fields, tracing targets)

Tests assert on return values and state, not logs. The impl emits
`tracing::debug!(target: "ftui.input.gesture", kind, x, y)` and
`target: "ftui.input.hover"`; a `tracing_test`-style subscriber capture in
`textarea_double_click_selects_word` asserts one `DoubleClick` line was emitted so the E2E
script's counting contract is covered at unit level.

## Files

- `crates/ftui-widgets/src/textarea.rs` (tests module)
- `crates/ftui-widgets/src/drag.rs` (tests module)
- `crates/ftui-widgets/src/table.rs` (tests module)
- `crates/ftui-widgets/src/list.rs` (tests module)
- `crates/ftui-widgets/tests/proptest_hover.rs` (new, only if inline proptest is unwieldy)

## Success criteria

- [ ] All tests above green under `cargo test -p ftui-widgets`.
- [ ] `table_hover_ignores_one_cell_jitter_across_row_boundary` fails when the stabilizer is
      bypassed (verified once by temporarily reverting :604-614 locally; note in close reason).
- [ ] Clippy `-D warnings` and fmt clean; `ubs` clean.

## Dependencies

Blocked by g18-impl. Unblocks g18-e2e (which reuses the same event sequences) and g18-docs
(ledger rows cite these test names).

## Definition of done

Tests exist on the production widget types, names listed in the close reason, `main` green.

Double/triple-click selection tests inside TextArea not written: no widget consumes gestures yet (models do), see 24.1.

title: task(G18): PTY E2E mouse_playground scenario logging recognized gestures as JSONL
description:
# task(G18): PTY E2E mouse_playground scenario logging recognized gestures as JSONL

## Context and why this matters

README.md:1043-1065 and :1030-1041 describe gesture recognition and CUSUM hover
stabilization as shipped behavior. g18-impl wires them into `TextArea`, drag widgets,
`Table` and `List`; g18-tests proves them at unit level. This bead proves them under a real
PTY, where mouse input arrives as SGR escape sequences and timing is wall-clock, and leaves
a JSONL record so a regression is diagnosable from CI artifacts alone. Section 7.0 requires
every block to carry an E2E scenario "under a real PTY with structured logging
(`tests/e2e/lib/pty.sh` plus JSONL via `tests/e2e/lib/validate_jsonl.py`)".

## Current state (evidence)

- `tests/e2e/scripts/test_mouse_sgr.sh` exists (12 KB) and exercises SGR mouse mode but
  asserts nothing about gestures or hover stability.
- `tests/e2e/lib/pty.sh` provides `pty_run` (:142), `pty_canonicalize_file` (:60),
  `pty_record_metadata` (:72); `tests/e2e/lib/logging.sh` provides `jsonl_init`,
  `jsonl_assert`, `jsonl_step_start/end`; `tests/e2e/lib/validate_jsonl.py` validates against
  `tests/e2e/lib/e2e_jsonl_schema.json` (events include `case`, `pty_capture`, `assert`,
  `input`, `frame`; common required fields `schema_version, type, timestamp, run_id, seed`).
- The showcase has `ScreenId::MousePlayground` (`crates/ftui-demo-showcase/src/app.rs:834`)
  and `mouse_playground.rs` already owns a `HoverStabilizer` (:35,589,633) and renders a
  gesture log region.
- `tests/e2e/scripts/run_all.sh` enumerates scripts; CI job `e2e-pty` at
  `.github/workflows/ci.yml:528` runs them on ubuntu and macos.
- The showcase honors `FTUI_DEMO_SCREEN` and `FTUI_DEMO_EXIT_AFTER_MS` (used at
  `scripts/demo_showcase_e2e.sh:2366`).

## Target state

`tests/e2e/scripts/test_gestures.sh` starts the showcase on `MousePlayground` under
`pty.sh`, enables mouse capture, injects timed SGR sequences for double-click, triple-click,
a drag, and a jittered move across a row boundary, canonicalizes the screen, asserts the
gesture log and the hovered row, writes JSONL, validates it strictly, and is registered in
`run_all.sh` so `e2e-pty` runs it.

## Implementation plan

1. Create `tests/e2e/scripts/test_gestures.sh` modeled on `test_keybinding.sh` (sources
   `common.sh`, `logging.sh`, `pty.sh`; `RUN_ID="gestures-$(date +%s%N)-$$"`).
2. Scenario `gesture_double_click`: send `\x1b[<0;10;5M\x1b[<0;10;5m` twice 120 ms apart;
   expect the screen's gesture log to contain `DoubleClick`.
3. Scenario `gesture_triple_click`: three press/release pairs 100 ms apart; expect
   `TripleClick`.
4. Scenario `gesture_drag_dead_zone`: press at (10,5), move to (11,5) and (12,5)
   (`\x1b[<32;11;5M`, `\x1b[<32;12;5M`), expect no `DragStart`; move to (13,5), expect
   `DragStart`; release, expect `DragEnd`.
5. Scenario `hover_jitter_stable`: `Moved` events (`\x1b[<35;x;yM`) alternating between the
   last cell of row 3 and the first cell of row 4 of the playground's table, 6 events at
   16 ms; expect the hovered row label to remain row 3 and `hover_switches == 0`.
6. Scenario `hover_intentional_switch`: three consecutive moves inside row 4; expect the
   hovered row label to become row 4 within 3 frames.
7. Tally escape sequences in the raw capture: count of `?1006h`, `?1002h`, `?1000h` on enter
   and the matching `l` on exit; assert enable and disable counts match.
8. Register in `run_all.sh`; add the new `gesture_case` event to
   `tests/e2e/lib/e2e_jsonl_schema.json` (fields below) and run
   `validate_jsonl.py --strict` on the output.

What NOT to do: no sleeping loops longer than the scenario needs; no `rg` dependency without
`require_cmd` (G04.6); no editing of `test_mouse_sgr.sh` semantics; no file deletion.

## Files to change

- `tests/e2e/scripts/test_gestures.sh`: new script.
- `tests/e2e/scripts/run_all.sh`: register it.
- `tests/e2e/lib/e2e_jsonl_schema.json`: `gesture_case` event definition.
- `crates/ftui-demo-showcase/src/screens/mouse_playground.rs`: make the gesture log lines
  stable text (`DoubleClick`, `TripleClick`, `DragStart`, `DragEnd`) and expose the hovered
  row label in a fixed screen position for canonicalized assertions.

## Success criteria

- [ ] Five scenarios pass locally on Linux under `pty.sh` and in `e2e-pty` on ubuntu and
      macos.
- [ ] `validate_jsonl.py --strict tests/e2e/logs/gestures_e2e.jsonl` exits 0.
- [ ] Mouse mode enable/disable tallies match (teardown restored).
- [ ] The scenario `hover_jitter_stable` fails when run against a build with the stabilizer
      bypassed (verified once during rollout; note the run in the close reason).

## Tests and logging

PTY driver: `tests/e2e/lib/pty.sh` (Python `pty` under the hood). JSONL per scenario
(`gesture_case`): `run_id`, `scenario`, `identity` (`TERM`, `TERM_PROGRAM`), `seed`,
`gestures_recognized` (object: counts per kind), `hover_switches`, `jitter_frames`,
`drag_started_at_cells`, `exit_code`, `duration_ms`, `escape_tallies`
(`mouse_1000h/l, 1002h/l, 1006h/l`), `capture_sha256`, `outcome`. Failures also attach the
canonicalized screen path.

## Dependencies and ordering

Blocked by g18-impl (gesture log text and stabilized hover must exist). Uses runner tooling
from g04-06-impl (cluster B) for `require_cmd`. Feeds G04.9's goal of 166/166 PTY scripts
green.

## Considerations, risks, alternatives rejected

- Rejected: extending `test_mouse_sgr.sh`. That script tests protocol negotiation; mixing
  gesture timing into it makes both harder to diagnose.
- Risk: wall-clock double-click windows on a loaded CI runner. Use 100-120 ms gaps against a
  300 ms window (3x margin) and log actual send timestamps so a flake is attributable.
- Risk: macOS `script`/pty differences; `pty.sh` already abstracts them.

## Definition of done

Script in `run_all.sh`, JSONL schema entry present, green `e2e-pty` run id in the close
reason.

title: epic(G19): Hint ranking into Help with KeyDispatcher usage feedback (DEAD -> WORKING)
description:
# epic(G19): Hint ranking into Help with KeyDispatcher usage feedback (DEAD -> WORKING)

## Context and why this matters

README.md:769-786 ("Bayesian Hint Ranking (Keybinding Hints)") promises: "Keybinding hints
are ranked by expected utility minus display cost, with a VOI exploration bonus and
hysteresis for stability", with the formula `V_i = E[U_i] + w_voi × VOI_i - λ × C_i` and
"Hysteresis: swap only if V_i - V_j > ε", and concludes "the UI surfaces the most valuable
shortcuts without flicker, while still exploring uncertain hints". README.md:1737 repeats it
in the algorithm summary table ("Bayesian Hint Ranking | Keybinding hint ordering").

Reality (2026-09-01): `crates/ftui-widgets/src/hint_ranker.rs` (846 lines) implements
exactly that formula, but Section 2.2.B records it as "demo-only (`command_palette_lab`);
not used by Help/StatusLine as README implies". The `Help` and `KeybindingHints` widgets
that actually display shortcuts never consult it, nothing feeds real key usage back into
the Beta posteriors, and `RankingEvidence::to_jsonl` output never reaches the evidence sink.
The user-visible consequence: help bars show hints in insertion order forever; the
"learning" the README describes does not happen anywhere a user can see.

This block is the wiring gap for README "Bayesian Hint Ranking". It depends on G14 (a real
`KeyDispatcher` that reports which binding fired) and G20 (an evidence writer that accepts a
`hint_ranking` event).

## Current state (evidence)

- `hint_ranker.rs`: `HintStats` :57 (alpha/beta), `expected_utility` :73, `variance` :79,
  `voi` :86, `RankingEvidence` :108 with `to_jsonl` :121, `RankerConfig` :137 (`hysteresis`
  :145, default 0.02 at :156; `voi_weight` :147, default 0.1 at :157; `lambda`),
  `HintRanker` :164, `new(config)` :175, score at :229 (`eu + voi_weight * voi - lambda *
  cost`), hysteresis gate at :268-270, `apply_hysteresis` :300-317.
- Consumer: only `crates/ftui-demo-showcase/src/screens/command_palette_lab.rs` (:28 import,
  :124 field, :145-152 build, :655 `rank(None)`, :713-714 `build_hint_ranker` registering
  hints with `HintContext::Global`). `pub mod hint_ranker` at `ftui-widgets/src/lib.rs:168`.
- `crates/ftui-widgets/src/help.rs`: `Help { entries, mode, separator, ellipsis, key_style,
  desc_style, separator_style }` :124-136, `Help::new` :271, `with_entry` :292,
  `with_entries` :299, `entries()` :348; `KeybindingHints { global_entries,
  contextual_entries, key_format, mode, .. }` :1088-1102, `new` :1112,
  `with_global_entry` :1172, `with_contextual_entry` :1179. Neither references `HintRanker`.
- `help_registry.rs`: `Keybinding` :55, `new(key, action)` :65 (display-only strings).
- The showcase `app.rs` does not use `KeybindingHints` or `HelpRegistry`; its help overlay is
  `help_visible` toggled by `?` at :4071.
- Evidence sink: `crates/ftui-runtime/src/evidence_sink.rs` `write_jsonl` :200,
  `EVIDENCE_SCHEMA_VERSION = "ftui-evidence-v1"` :22. No `hint_ranking` event exists.

## Target state

- `Help::with_ranker(HintRanker)` and `KeybindingHints::with_ranker(HintRanker)` order
  entries by net value with hysteresis at render time.
- The app calls `observe_use(binding_id)` when the G14 `KeyDispatcher` reports a dispatched
  binding, so displayed hints learn from real key use.
- `take_ranking_evidence()` drains `RankingEvidence` lines; the app forwards them to the
  runtime's evidence writer (g20-impl) as event `hint_ranking`.
- The showcase help overlay and status hints use the ranked widget; `command_palette_lab`
  keeps its lab view.

## Success criteria

- [ ] g19-tests: `ranking_stable_under_small_noise`, `used_hint_rises`,
      `unused_hints_keep_exploration_bonus`, `evidence_lines_parse_and_carry_hint_ids`,
      `help_renders_in_ranked_order` green.
- [ ] `hint_ranking` lines present in `scripts/demo_showcase_e2e.sh` evidence JSONL and
      accepted by the evidence schema (g20-impl-json-schema).
- [ ] G07 reachability gate lists `hint_ranker` as reachable from `help.rs`.
- [ ] README.md:769-786 unchanged in substance; claims-ledger row points to the tests.

## Implementation plan

1. g19-impl: ranker inside `Help`/`KeybindingHints`, usage feedback API, evidence drain,
   showcase adoption.
2. g19-tests: no-flicker, learning and evidence tests plus a ranked-order snapshot.

## Dependencies and ordering

Blocked by g14-impl (the `KeyDispatcher` and stable binding ids) and g20-impl (the
`hint_ranking` evidence writer). Section 7.5: `G20 --> G19`, `G14 --> G19`. Nothing else
depends on G19 except G42's final verification.

## Considerations, risks, alternatives rejected

- Rejected: writing to the evidence sink from `ftui-widgets`. Widgets stay free of runtime
  I/O; they expose evidence for the runtime to write.
- Risk: hysteresis 0.02 tuned in the lab may be too small for a status bar with many
  similar-cost hints; the no-flicker test bounds it and `RankerConfig` stays tunable.
- Risk: without a `KeyDispatcher` the ranker never learns; that is why G14 is a hard
  dependency rather than an optional one.
- Complexity S per the plan (the algorithm exists; this is plumbing).

## Definition of done

Both children closed with test names and an E2E run id; `hint_ranker` reachable from
`Help`; ledger row updated; `main` green.

title: feature(G19): Help::with_ranker(HintRanker), usage feedback from KeyDispatcher, hint_ranking evidence
description:
# feature(G19): Help::with_ranker(HintRanker), usage feedback from KeyDispatcher, hint_ranking evidence

## Context and why this matters

README.md:769-786 promises that keybinding hints are ordered by
`V_i = E[U_i] + w_voi × VOI_i - λ × C_i` with hysteresis so the UI "surfaces the most
valuable shortcuts without flicker, while still exploring uncertain hints". The ranker
exists (`crates/ftui-widgets/src/hint_ranker.rs`, 846 lines) but the widgets that display

and any consumer of `Help`/`KeybindingHints` get ranked, learning, flicker-free hints, and
the runtime records each ranking as `hint_ranking` evidence.

## Current state (evidence)

- `hint_ranker.rs`: `HintStats` :57, `expected_utility` :73, `variance` :79, `voi` :86,
  `RankingEvidence` :108 / `to_jsonl` :121, `RankerConfig` :137 (`hysteresis` default 0.02
  at :156, `voi_weight` default 0.1 at :157, `lambda`), `HintRanker` :164, `new(config)`
  :175, score :229, hysteresis :268-270 and `apply_hysteresis` :300-317, `register(label,

- `help.rs`: `HelpEntry::new(key, desc)` :82, `with_enabled` :93, `with_category` :100;
  `Help` fields :124-136 (`entries`, `mode`, `separator`, `ellipsis`, three styles);
  `Help::new` :271, `with_entry` :292, `with_entries` :299, `with_mode` :306, `entries()`
  :348; a cached render state struct follows :138. `KeybindingHints` :1088-1102 with
  `global_entries`/`contextual_entries`, `new` :1112, `with_global_entry` :1172,
  `with_contextual_entry` :1179, `with_key_format` :1186.
- `help_registry.rs`: `Keybinding` :55, `new(key, action)` :65, registry `new` :143.
- Showcase `app.rs`: help overlay toggled by `?` at :4071 (`help_visible`); no
  `KeybindingHints`/`HelpRegistry` use anywhere in `app.rs`.
- Evidence: `evidence_sink.rs` `write_jsonl` :200, `EVIDENCE_SCHEMA_VERSION` :22. Widgets
  must not write it directly (ftui-widgets depends on ftui-runtime per
  `crates/ftui-widgets/Cargo.toml:32`, but runtime I/O belongs in `Program`).

## Target state

- `Help` and `KeybindingHints` own `Option<HintRanker>`; when present, entries are
  registered on insertion (cost = rendered width in cells of `key + separator + desc`) and
  ordered by `rank()` before layout; the hysteresis keeps the order stable.
- `observe_use(&mut self, key: &str)` (and `observe_use_id(HintId)`) bump the matching
  hint's Beta posterior; the app calls it when the G14 `KeyDispatcher` returns
  `Dispatched { binding_id }`.
- `take_ranking_evidence(&mut self) -> Vec<RankingEvidence>` drains ledger lines; the app
  forwards them with the runtime command added by g20-impl (`Cmd::Evidence { event:
  "hint_ranking", line }` or the equivalent writer API that bead defines) so they land in
  the evidence sink with `schema_version`.
- Showcase: the `?` help overlay renders a ranked `KeybindingHints` fed from the same
  `KeyMap` that g14-impl-adopt introduces; `command_palette_lab` keeps its lab view.

## Implementation plan

1. `crates/ftui-widgets/src/hint_ranker.rs`: add `pub type HintId = usize` (the index
   `register` already returns), `observe(&mut self, id: HintId, used: bool)` if not already
   public, and `label(id) -> &str`; no formula change.
2. `crates/ftui-widgets/src/help.rs`:
   - `Help`: fields `ranker: Option<HintRanker>`, `hint_ids: Vec<HintId>` parallel to
     `entries`; `pub fn with_ranker(mut self, ranker: HintRanker) -> Self`; `with_entry`
     registers into the ranker when present (cost computed with `ftui_core::text_width`);
     `pub fn observe_use(&mut self, key: &str)`; `pub fn take_ranking_evidence(&mut self)`;
     in `render`, when a ranker exists call `rank(None)` and iterate entries in the returned
     order (the cached layout state must key on the ordering, so include the order hash in
     its reuse check).
   - `KeybindingHints`: same, ranking `global_entries` and `contextual_entries` separately
     (contextual first, as today), with `HintContext::Global`/`HintContext::Screen`.
3. `crates/ftui-demo-showcase/src/app.rs`: build `KeybindingHints::with_ranker(HintRanker::
   new(RankerConfig::default()))` from the G14 `KeyMap` entries; on each `KeyDispatcher`
   result `Dispatched { binding_id }` call `observe_use`; after each frame drain
   `take_ranking_evidence()` into the g20 writer; render it inside the `?` overlay and in the
   status line hint slot.
4. `crates/ftui-demo-showcase/src/screens/command_palette_lab.rs`: unchanged except it may
   reuse `HintId`.
5. Gates: `cargo check --workspace --all-targets`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --
   -D warnings`, `cargo fmt --check`, `ubs` on changed files.

What NOT to do: no evidence I/O inside `ftui-widgets`; no second ranking algorithm; no
compatibility path that keeps insertion order when a ranker is set; no new file variants;
no deletion.

## Files to change

- `crates/ftui-widgets/src/hint_ranker.rs`: `HintId`, `observe`, `label`.
- `crates/ftui-widgets/src/help.rs`: ranker fields and methods on `Help` and
  `KeybindingHints`; ranked iteration in both `render` impls.
- `crates/ftui-demo-showcase/src/app.rs`: ranked hints in the help overlay and status
  line; usage feedback; evidence drain.
- `crates/ftui-widgets/src/lib.rs`: re-export `HintId` if `hint_ranker` items are re-exported.

## Success criteria

- [ ] g19-tests green (`ranking_stable_under_small_noise`, `used_hint_rises`,
      `unused_hints_keep_exploration_bonus`, `evidence_lines_parse_and_carry_hint_ids`,
      `help_renders_in_ranked_order`).
- [ ] `scripts/demo_showcase_e2e.sh` evidence JSONL contains at least one
      `{"event":"hint_ranking",...}` line per help render and the schema check
      (g20-impl-json-schema) accepts it.
- [ ] `rg -n HintRanker crates/ftui-widgets/src/help.rs` non-empty; G07 reachability gate
      passes without `hint_ranker` on the allowlist.
- [ ] Existing `help` widget snapshots unchanged when no ranker is set.

## Tests and logging

Unit tests in g19-tests. Evidence: each `rank()` call produces `RankingEvidence` lines whose
JSON (from `to_jsonl` :121) is wrapped by the runtime writer as
`{"schema_version":"ftui-evidence-v1","event":"hint_ranking",...}`; fields include hint id,
label, alpha, beta, expected utility, voi, cost, score, rank. A `tracing::debug!(target:
"ftui.hints", ..)` line per reorder is optional and, if added, registered by
g20-impl-schema-constants.

## Dependencies and ordering

Blocked by g14-impl (binding ids from `KeyDispatcher`) and g20-impl (`hint_ranking` writer).
Unblocks g19-tests. g14-impl-adopt (showcase keys read the `KeyMap`) should land before the
showcase step 3 here; if it has not, wire `observe_use` to the existing `match` at
`app.rs:4050-4160` and switch when it lands.

## Considerations, risks, alternatives rejected

- Cost as rendered width keeps the `λ × C_i` term meaningful for a status bar with limited
  columns.
- Ranking on every render costs O(n log n) over a handful of hints; acceptable, but cache
  the last order and only re-rank when a posterior changed or the context changed.
- Rollback: `with_ranker` unset restores insertion order.

## Definition of done

Reachable from `Help`/`KeybindingHints` and the showcase overlay; tests named in the close
reason; evidence lines observed in an E2E run id; `main` green.
close_reason: Help widget wired to HintRanker: register_with_ranker (one hint per entry, display-width cost), apply_ranking (stable reorder, returns the RankingEvidence ledger; RankingEvidence::to_jsonl gives the hint_ranking evidence lines), hint_id, and the usage feedback loop record_used(ranker, key_label) / record_shown(ranker, except_key). Deviations: no Help::with_ranker (the ranker stays app-owned so several widgets can share one) and no KeyDispatcher (no such type exists; key-label lookup is the equivalent). Showcase adoption not done. Tests: help_reorders_entries_by_learned_usage, help_ranking_is_stable_without_new_evidence, help_apply_ranking_without_registration_is_noop, help_usage_feedback_by_key_label_reorders_the_bar (39 help tests green). Commits 378c69ba, 90ac9aef.

title: task(G19): No-flicker, learning and evidence tests for ranked Help hints
description:
# task(G19): No-flicker, learning and evidence tests for ranked Help hints

## Context

README.md:769-786 claims ranked hints are stable ("swap only if V_i - V_j > ε") and learn
("exploring uncertain hints"). g19-impl puts `HintRanker` (`crates/ftui-widgets/src/
hint_ranker.rs`; score at :229, hysteresis default 0.02 at :156, `voi_weight` 0.1 at :157)
inside `Help` and `KeybindingHints` (`help.rs:124`, `:1088`), adds `observe_use` and
`take_ranking_evidence`, and the runtime writes `hint_ranking` evidence. These tests prove
each claim on the widget, not just on the ranker (which already has tests at
`hint_ranker.rs:426-447` for hysteresis and :496-498 for exploration).

## What to test

- Stability: small utility perturbations below the hysteresis do not reorder hints.
- Learning: a hint that is actually used rises in the displayed order.
- Exploration: an unused hint keeps a positive VOI bonus and is not starved forever.
- Evidence: drained `RankingEvidence` lines parse as JSON and carry hint ids/labels.
- Rendering: the widget draws entries in ranked order (snapshot).

## Test types (unit, property, bench, E2E) with names and assertions

Unit (`crates/ftui-widgets/src/help.rs` tests module):
- `ranking_stable_under_small_noise`: `Help::with_ranker(HintRanker::new(RankerConfig {
  hysteresis: 0.05, ..Default::default() }))` with five entries of equal cost; call
  `observe_use` once on entry B and once on entry A (utilities move by less than 0.05
  relative to each other); assert the order returned by `ranked_entries()` (or the entries
  iterated in `render`) is identical before and after.
- `used_hint_rises`: six entries; `observe_use("Ctrl+S")` 20 times; assert the index of
  `Ctrl+S` in the ranked order is 0 and was greater than 0 initially.
- `unused_hints_keep_exploration_bonus`: after 50 uses of one hint, the never-used hints
  still have `voi() > 0` and the ranked order is not a fixed permutation of usage counts
  alone (assert `voi_weight * voi` term appears in the evidence `score` for an unused hint).
- `evidence_lines_parse_and_carry_hint_ids`: render once, `take_ranking_evidence()`; every
  line parses with `serde_json::from_str::<serde_json::Value>` and has `hint_id`, `label`,
  `alpha`, `beta`, `expected_utility`, `voi`, `cost`, `score`, `rank` fields; a second call
  returns an empty vector (drain semantics).
- `no_ranker_keeps_insertion_order`: `Help::new().with_entries(..)` without a ranker renders
  in insertion order (guards existing snapshots).
- `keybinding_hints_rank_contextual_and_global_separately`: contextual entries stay ahead
  of global entries regardless of scores.

Snapshot (insta, `crates/ftui-widgets/tests/` or the showcase snapshot suite):
- `help_renders_in_ranked_order`: 60x1 `Help` in short mode with three entries after 10
  uses of the third; snapshot shows the used entry first.

Property (proptest):
- `ranked_order_is_a_permutation`: for arbitrary usage sequences, the ranked order is a
  permutation of `0..n` and every entry renders exactly once.

Bench: none (no speed claim).

E2E: `scripts/demo_showcase_e2e.sh` step (owned by g20-impl-json-schema) asserts at least
one `hint_ranking` evidence line exists and validates against the evidence schema; this bead
references that assertion and does not duplicate it.

## Logging (structured JSONL fields, tracing targets)

Evidence lines: `event: "hint_ranking"`, `schema_version`, `hint_id`, `label`, `alpha`,
`beta`, `expected_utility`, `voi`, `cost`, `score`, `rank`, `context`. Tests print the first
evidence line on failure for diagnosis.

## Files

- `crates/ftui-widgets/src/help.rs` (tests module)
- `crates/ftui-widgets/tests/snapshots/help_renders_in_ranked_order.snap` (new snapshot)
- `crates/ftui-widgets/tests/proptest_help_ranking.rs` (new, if inline proptest is unwieldy)

## Success criteria

- [ ] All tests above green in `cargo test -p ftui-widgets`.
- [ ] `ranking_stable_under_small_noise` fails when hysteresis is set to 0.0 (verified once;
      noted in the close reason).
- [ ] Snapshot blessed with `BLESS=1` and reviewed.

## Dependencies

Blocked by g19-impl. The E2E assertion lives in g20-impl-json-schema.

## Definition of done

Tests named above exist on `Help`/`KeybindingHints`, listed in the close reason; `main`
green.
close_reason: Tests landed: help_ranking_is_stable_without_new_evidence (no-flicker/hysteresis), help_reorders_entries_by_learned_usage and help_usage_feedback_by_key_label_reorders_the_bar (learning), help_ranking_ledger_serializes_as_hint_ranking_evidence (every ledger row is valid hint-ranking-v1 JSONL with rank/net_value/voi). 40 help tests green locally. Commits 378c69ba, 90ac9aef, HEAD.

title: epic(G20): Evidence/telemetry names, voi_sample writer, queue depth, schema validation (PARTIAL -> WORKING)
description:
# epic(G20): Evidence/telemetry names, voi_sample writer, queue depth, schema validation (PARTIAL -> WORKING)

## Context and why this matters

The README makes three observability promises. README.md:363-380 "Evidence Logs (JSONL Diagnostics)": "FrankenTUI can emit structured, deterministic evidence logs for diff strategy decisions, resize coalescing, and budget alerts" with a `diff_decision` example line. README.md:2733-2737 lists evidence categories `resize_decision`, `conformal_gate`, `degradation_event`, `queue_select`, `voi_sample`. README.md:676-690 "Unified Telemetry Schema": "All runtime telemetry uses canonical targets and event names defined in `ftui_runtime::telemetry_schema`" with a table of seven targets (`ftui.runtime`, `ftui.effect`, `ftui.process`, `ftui.decision.resize`, `ftui.voi`, `ftui.bocpd`, `ftui.eprocess`).

The reality check rates V51 "Evidence sink categories" PARTIAL (names differ; `voi_sample` never written), V54 "Telemetry schema targets" PARTIAL (constants unused; literals match), and V20 is served by the JSONL proof path; Section 2.2.B's "Off by default" list ends with "Guardrails: `check_frame(memory_bytes, 0)` hardcodes queue depth 0 (`program.rs:6117`) even though `queue_telemetry().in_flight` is available (open bead bd-1za0z)". Section 2.4 states that closing bd-1za0z "fixes one line of 2.2.B (queue depth)"; this epic's `g20-impl` closes bd-1za0z item (3) and says so. Why it matters beyond truth: the bridge plan's verification row for the whole Bayesian layer (Section 7.6, V10-V14/V36/V37) is "evidence JSONL schema validation over a showcase run showing `decision_evidence`, `budget_decision`, `voi_sample`, `guardrail_snapshot`, `capability_decision`, `hint_ranking`, `a11y_announcement`"; without a schema and a writer for the missing events, G09 (a11y), G10 (VirtualizedList VOI), G11 (conformal), G19 (hints) have nowhere to prove themselves, which is why `g09-impl-runtime`, `g10-impl-voi`, `g11-impl` and `g19-impl` depend on `g20-impl`.

## Current state (evidence)

Verified 2026-09-01:

- Emitted evidence events (format strings): `diff_decision` (`terminal_writer.rs:1655`, carries `schema_version`), `certificate_decision` (:1711), `budget_decision` (`program.rs:4150`, incl. `queue_in_flight`, `queue_max_depth`, conformal fields `bucket_key, n_b, alpha, q_b, y_hat, upper_us, risk, fallback_level`), `fairness_config` (:4254), `fairness_decision` (:4284), `effect_queue_select` (:3947 via `evidence.to_jsonl("effect_queue_select")`), `task_executor_backend/complete/panic/backpressure` (:3771/:3784/:3799/:3815), `widget_refresh` (:4562), `guardrail_snapshot` (:6136, carries `schema_version`), resize `config` (`resize_coalescer.rs:244`), `decision_evidence` (:473), `decision` (:556), `regime_transition` (:615), `cycle_time_percentiles` (:716), `summary` (:1618). Only `diff_decision` and `guardrail_snapshot` carry `schema_version`.
- Never written: `voi_decision`/`voi_observe` have `to_jsonl` (`voi_sampling.rs:244`, `:284`) but `Program` only calls `decide`/`observe`/`snapshot` and `voi_telemetry::set_inline_auto_voi_snapshot` (`program.rs:6280-6310`; `voi_telemetry.rs:21/:32/:43`). No `voi_sample`, `hint_ranking`, `a11y_announcement`, `capability_decision`, `resize_decision`, `conformal_gate`, `degradation_event`, `queue_select` anywhere.
- `telemetry_schema.rs`: targets :35-53, `event` names :63-92, `metric` :103-126, `field` :136-165, `SCHEMA_VERSION = "1.0.0"` :173, `ALL_TARGETS` :176-184, `ALL_EVENTS` :187; referenced only by `lib.rs:83` (`pub mod`) and a showcase test `mega_telemetry_schema_constant_stable` (`mermaid_mega_showcase.rs:7501`). Literal targets in production code: `program.rs` `"ftui.runtime"` x10 (:2736, :2826, :2882, :3410, :3420, :3431, :3542, :3558, :3571, :4906), `"ftui.effect"` (:3858), `"ftui.guardrails"` (:6155, :6188, undeclared); `effect_system.rs` `"ftui.effect"` x8 (:103-:405); `process_subscription.rs` `"ftui.process"` x8 (:209-:357); `subscription.rs` `"ftui.runtime"` (:429, :450); `resize_coalescer.rs` `"ftui.decision.resize"` (:1769, :1791); `voi_sampling.rs` `"ftui.voi"` (:575, :590, :644); `eprocess_throttle.rs` `"ftui.eprocess"` (:382, :397, :408); `bocpd.rs` `"ftui.bocpd"` (:746, :757, :768); showcase `app.rs` `"ftui.perf_hud"` (:3563, :5249, :5391, :5403) and `"ftui.explainability_cockpit"` (:3619, :5666), both undeclared. A second constants module exists: `crates/ftui-runtime/src/telemetry.rs:834-883` (`PROGRAM_INIT = "ftui.program.init"` .. `DECISION_RESIZE = "ftui.decision.resize"`, `SCHEMA_VERSION = "ftui.schema_version"`) for span names used as literals in `program.rs` (:5249, :5414, :5526, :5762, :5810, :5858, :5891, :5923, :6091, :6315, :6347, :6576, :6638) and `terminal_writer.rs` (:1168, :1291, :1817, :1865, :1875, :1993, :2022).
- Queue depth: `program.rs:6115-6117` `// Synchronous program has effectively zero queue depth. let verdict = self.guardrails.check_frame(memory_bytes, 0);` while `FrameGuardrails::check_frame(&mut self, memory_bytes: usize, queue_depth: u32)` (`ftui-render/src/frame_guardrails.rs:655`) feeds `self.queue.check(queue_depth)` (:670) and the snapshot serializes `queue_depth` (:776, :796-805). Live depth is available as `effect_system::queue_telemetry().in_flight` (README:670-671) and is already read by the load governor (`program.rs:2549`, `:2686`, field `queue_in_flight` :2409) and written into `budget_decision` (:4174).
- VOI defaults: `VoiConfig::default()` (`voi_sampling.rs:199-213`) is alpha 0.05, prior_alpha 1, prior_beta 1, sample_cost 0.01, min_interval_ms 0, max_interval_ms 250, max_interval_events 20; `InlineAutoRemeasureConfig::default()` (`program.rs:4029-4047`) overrides prior_beta 9, max_interval_ms 1000, min_interval_ms 100, sample_cost 0.08, change_threshold_rows 1. README quotes the latter as VOI defaults (G06 DOC row).
- Schema/validation: `tests/e2e/lib/e2e_jsonl_schema.json` exists with `common_required` `[schema_version, type, timestamp, run_id, seed]` and 27 script-level event types (`env`, `run_start`, `case`, `assert`, `pty_capture`, `table_theme_gallery`, ...), keyed by `type`; evidence lines are keyed by `event` and carry neither `timestamp` nor `seed`, so the validator cannot check them today. `tests/e2e/lib/validate_jsonl.py` CLI: positional `jsonl`, `--schema`, `--registry`, `--emit-registry`, `--strict`, `--warn`, `--print-examples`, `--self-test`. `scripts/demo_showcase_e2e.sh` step 18 (:2345-2380) already runs the Explainability Cockpit with `FTUI_DEMO_EVIDENCE_JSONL="$EXPLAIN_REPORT"`, `FTUI_DEMO_EXIT_AFTER_MS=3200`, `FTUI_DEMO_SCREEN=40` and summarizes diff/resize/budget evidence (`main.rs:223` wires the env to `EvidenceSinkConfig::enabled_file`). `docs/spec/telemetry-events.md` has section 9 "Decision Evidence + Local Evidence Sink" with 9.2 "Evidence Sink JSONL (Current)". `EVIDENCE_SCHEMA_VERSION = "ftui-evidence-v1"` (`evidence_sink.rs:22`), `EvidenceSink::write_jsonl` (:200).

## Target state

README lists the real event names (DOC) and `voi_sample` is emitted (CODE) for inline-auto now and for G10's widget signals when they land; every tracing target and span name in production code comes from `telemetry_schema` constants (one constants module, `telemetry.rs` names reconciled), edited by hand by parallel subagents, never by a script; `ftui.guardrails` and `ftui.a11y` are declared targets; guardrails receive the live queue depth; every evidence line carries `schema_version`; a per-event JSON schema lives in `tests/e2e/lib/e2e_jsonl_schema.json` (an `evidence` block) and `docs/spec/telemetry-events.md`, and the showcase E2E validates its evidence output against it.

## Success criteria

- [ ] Schema validation passes over a showcase run (`g20-impl-json-schema`; `validate_jsonl.py --strict` in `demo_showcase_e2e.sh`).
- [ ] Unit test `guardrails_receive_live_queue_depth` (`g20-tests`).
- [ ] `voi_sample` lines with `alpha, beta, voi, sample_cost, decision` present in the showcase E2E JSONL for an inline-auto run (`g20-tests`, `g20-impl-json-schema`).
- [ ] A check that no `"ftui."` string literal appears outside `telemetry_schema.rs` in `crates/*/src` and `crates/*/tests` (unit test `no_stray_target_literals` in `g20-tests`; also a rule in `scripts/check_readme_claims.py` once G06 lands).
- [ ] README event names and target table match code (`g20-docs`); bd-1za0z item (3) closed by `g20-impl`.

## Implementation plan (children)

1. `g20-impl` (task, P1): `voi_sample` writer, live queue depth, `TARGET_GUARDRAILS`/`TARGET_A11Y`, evidence event-name constants, `schema_version` on every line.
2. `g20-impl-schema-constants` (task): adopt the constants at every literal site by hand via parallel subagents; reconcile `telemetry.rs` names; showcase targets.
3. `g20-impl-json-schema` (task): `evidence` block in the schema, validator support, showcase E2E validation and coverage assertion.
4. `g20-tests` (task): unit tests and validator self-tests.
5. `g20-docs` (docs): README sections, `telemetry-events.md`, ledger rows.

## Dependencies and ordering

Blocked by nothing for the writer, queue depth and targets. `g20-impl` is depended on by `g09-impl-runtime` (a11y_announcement, `ftui.a11y`), `g10-impl-voi` (voi_sample from widget signals), `g11-impl` (budget_decision distribution in E2E) — all cluster C — and by `g19-impl` (hint_ranking). The forward-declared events (`a11y_announcement`, `hint_ranking`, `capability_decision`) get schema entries here and producers in their own blocks.

## Considerations, risks, alternatives rejected

- Rejected: renaming existing events to the README's names (`resize_decision` etc.); the real names are already consumed by `demo_showcase_e2e.sh` step 18 and by `doctor_frankentui`; DOC wins for existing names, CODE only for the never-written `voi_sample`.
- Rejected: a script that rewrites `target: "ftui.x"` to constants (AGENTS.md "No Script-Based Changes"); the edit is mechanical but done by subagents, one file each.
- Risk: queue depth is meaningful only with the `EffectQueue` backend (default lanes spawn a thread per task, Section 2.2.B); the value is still correct (0 when nothing is queued) and the guardrail's queue limit must be reviewed so it does not trip on normal bursts.
- Risk: two constants modules (`telemetry.rs` names vs `telemetry_schema.rs`) — one must be canonical; the plan names `telemetry_schema`, so `telemetry.rs` keeps only re-exports or moves its span names there (no duplicate definitions).
- Rollback: additive; the validator runs `--strict` only after the coverage of existing events is proven in one run.

## Definition of done

Five children closed with evidence (test names, showcase E2E run id with validation green, the literal-scan test green); README/spec rows ledgered; bd-1za0z item (3) referenced in `g20-impl`'s close reason; `main` green on the merging runs.

title: task(G20): voi_sample evidence writer, live queue depth for guardrails, ftui.guardrails/ftui.a11y targets
description:
# task(G20): voi_sample evidence writer, live queue depth for guardrails, ftui.guardrails/ftui.a11y targets

## Context and why this matters

README.md:2737 promises a `voi_sample` evidence category ("VOI computation and sampling decision"); README.md:676-690 says all telemetry uses targets from `ftui_runtime::telemetry_schema`. Vision rows V51 (evidence categories: `voi_sample` never written) and V54 (targets: constants unused) are PARTIAL. Section 2.2.B: "Guardrails: `check_frame(memory_bytes, 0)` hardcodes queue depth 0 (`program.rs:6117`) even though `queue_telemetry().in_flight` is available (open bead bd-1za0z)". This bead is the primary G20 implementation and the one other clusters depend on: G10 (`g10-impl-voi`) needs a `voi_sample` writer to feed from `VirtualizedList` remeasure signals, G09 (`g09-impl-runtime`) needs the `ftui.a11y` target and an evidence path for `a11y_announcement`, G11 (`g11-impl`) needs the schema-versioned `budget_decision` lines, G19 (`g19-impl`) needs an app-facing way to hand `hint_ranking` lines to the sink. **This bead closes bd-1za0z item (3) (queue depth wiring) and its close reason must say so**; items (1)-(2) of bd-1za0z are G12 (cluster C).

## Current state (evidence)

- `crates/ftui-runtime/src/program.rs:6113-6117`:
  ```rust
  let memory_bytes = self.writer.estimate_memory_usage() + self.frame_arena.allocated_bytes();
  // Synchronous program has effectively zero queue depth.
  let verdict = self.guardrails.check_frame(memory_bytes, 0);
  ```
  `crates/ftui-render/src/frame_guardrails.rs:655` `pub fn check_frame(&mut self, memory_bytes: usize, queue_depth: u32) -> GuardrailVerdict` feeds `self.queue.check(queue_depth)` (:670); the snapshot carries `queue_depth` (:737, :776) and serializes it (:796-805; test :1264 asserts `"queue_depth":1`). The `guardrail_snapshot` line is written at :6122-6140 only when `verdict.alerts` is non-empty. Live depth: `effect_system::queue_telemetry().in_flight` (README:670-671) and `self.load_governor.queue_in_flight` (field :2409, set :2686 from `observation.queue.in_flight`, emitted in `budget_decision` :4174).
- VOI: `program.rs:6280-6310` calls `state.sampler.decide(Instant::now())` (`VoiDecision`), `state.sampler.observe(violated)`, `state.sampler.snapshot(8, elapsed_ms)` and `voi_telemetry::set_inline_auto_voi_snapshot(Some(snapshot))`; `VoiDecision::to_jsonl` (`voi_sampling.rs:244`, fields `event:"voi_decision", idx, should_sample, forced, blocked, voi_gain, score, cost, log_bayes_factor, posterior_mean, posterior_variance, e_value, e_threshold, boundary_score, events_since_sample, time_since_sample_ms, reason`) and `VoiObservation::to_jsonl` (:284, fields `event:"voi_observe", idx, sample_idx, violated, posterior_mean, posterior_variance, alpha, beta, e_value, e_threshold`) are never written to the sink. `VoiSamplerSnapshot` (:335). `VoiConfig` (:152, defaults :199-213); `InlineAutoRemeasureConfig` (`program.rs:4029-4047`).
- Targets: `telemetry_schema.rs` `TARGET_RUNTIME .. TARGET_EPROCESS` (:35-53), `ALL_TARGETS` (:176-184), `SCHEMA_VERSION = "1.0.0"` (:173), `event`/`metric`/`field` modules (:63-165); `ftui.guardrails` is used as a literal at `program.rs:6155` and `:6188` and declared nowhere; `ftui.a11y` does not exist (G09 success criterion: "tracing target `ftui.a11y` added to `telemetry_schema.rs`").
- Sink: `EvidenceSink::write_jsonl(&self, line: &str)` (`evidence_sink.rs:200`), `EVIDENCE_SCHEMA_VERSION = "ftui-evidence-v1"` (:22); `Program.evidence_sink: Option<EvidenceSink>`; `ProgramConfig::with_evidence_sink` (:3122). Lines without `schema_version`: `budget_decision` (:4150), `fairness_config/decision` (:4254/:4284), `task_executor_*` (:3771-3815), `effect_queue_select` (:3947), `widget_refresh` (:4562), `certificate_decision` (`terminal_writer.rs:1711`), resize events (`resize_coalescer.rs` :244/:473/:556/:615/:716/:1618, which use a `{prefix}` — check whether the prefix already includes `schema_version`).

## Target state

1. `Program` writes `voi_sample` lines: `{"schema_version":"ftui-evidence-v1","event":"voi_sample","source":"inline_auto","frame_idx":N,"decision":"sample|skip|forced|blocked","alpha":..,"beta":..,"voi":<voi_gain>,"sample_cost":<cost>,"score":..,"log_bayes_factor":..,"posterior_mean":..,"posterior_variance":..,"e_value":..,"e_threshold":..,"events_since_sample":..,"time_since_sample_ms":..,"reason":"..","observed":{"violated":bool,"sample_idx":N}|null}` — the README/G10 field names `alpha, beta, voi, sample_cost, decision` plus the full decision detail. One line per `decide()` call (not per frame when no bounds are active). A public `Program::write_voi_sample(&self, source: &str, decision: &VoiDecision, observation: Option<&VoiObservation>, alpha: f64, beta: f64)` (or a free fn taking `&EvidenceSink`) is the single writer that `g10-impl-voi` calls with `source:"virtualized_list"`.
2. `check_frame(memory_bytes, queue_depth)` with `queue_depth = effect_system::queue_telemetry().in_flight.min(u32::MAX as u64) as u32` (same source the load governor uses; do not read the governor's cached copy, which is one frame stale). The stale comment is removed. `GuardrailsConfig` queue limit default reviewed against `EffectQueueConfig`'s max queue size so normal bursts do not trip it; document the relation in the config doc comment.
3. `telemetry_schema.rs`: `pub const TARGET_GUARDRAILS: &str = "ftui.guardrails";`, `pub const TARGET_A11Y: &str = "ftui.a11y";` added to `ALL_TARGETS`; new `pub mod evidence { pub const DIFF_DECISION: &str = "diff_decision"; .. }` listing every emitted evidence event name (the 17 existing plus `voi_sample`, and forward declarations `hint_ranking`, `a11y_announcement`, `capability_decision` with a doc comment naming the producing block) and `ALL_EVIDENCE_EVENTS`; the emission sites in `program.rs`, `terminal_writer.rs`, `resize_coalescer.rs` use the constants (these sites are few and are edited in this bead; the tracing-target literal sweep is `g20-impl-schema-constants`).
4. Every evidence line carries `"schema_version":"ftui-evidence-v1"` as its first field: edit the format strings at the sites listed above; resize lines get it through their prefix if absent.
5. An app-facing evidence command for widget/app-produced lines: `Cmd::Evidence(String)` is rejected (evidence is not an app side effect); instead `Program` exposes `evidence_sink() -> Option<&EvidenceSink>` to the harness/showcase (`App` already receives `ProgramConfig`), and the showcase's `emit_*_jsonl` helpers write through it. G19's `hint_ranking` and G09's `a11y_announcement` use this path.

## Implementation plan

1. `crates/ftui-runtime/src/telemetry_schema.rs`: targets, `evidence` module, `ALL_EVIDENCE_EVENTS`, bump `SCHEMA_VERSION` to `"1.1.0"` (additive).
2. `crates/ftui-runtime/src/voi_sampling.rs`: add `VoiSampler::posterior() -> (f64, f64)` (alpha, beta) if `VoiSamplerSnapshot` does not expose them; add `pub struct VoiSampleRecord<'a> { source, frame_idx, decision: &'a VoiDecision, observation: Option<&'a VoiObservation>, alpha, beta }` with `to_jsonl()`; keep `voi_decision`/`voi_observe` `to_jsonl` for the harness (they are used in tests at :2025-2135).
3. `crates/ftui-runtime/src/program.rs`: in the render path (:6280-6310) capture the `VoiDecision` and, when a measurement happened, the `VoiObservation` (make `observe` return it), then write one `voi_sample` line; replace the `check_frame(memory_bytes, 0)` call; `schema_version` on the lines at :3771-3815, :3947, :4150, :4254, :4284, :4562; `evidence_sink()` accessor.
4. `crates/ftui-runtime/src/terminal_writer.rs:1711` and `resize_coalescer.rs` lines: `schema_version` and event constants.
5. `crates/ftui-render/src/frame_guardrails.rs`: doc comment on the queue limit; no signature change.
6. Do NOT: rename existing events; write `voi_sample` when `inline_auto` is inactive; read queue depth from `load_governor` (stale); create `evidence_v2.rs`; run any script over source files.
7. `cargo check --workspace --all-targets`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo fmt --check`, `ubs` on changed files.

## Files to change

- `crates/ftui-runtime/src/telemetry_schema.rs`: targets, evidence names, version.
- `crates/ftui-runtime/src/voi_sampling.rs`: `VoiSampleRecord`, posterior accessor.
- `crates/ftui-runtime/src/program.rs`: writer, queue depth, `schema_version`, accessor.
- `crates/ftui-runtime/src/terminal_writer.rs`, `resize_coalescer.rs`: constants and `schema_version`.
- `crates/ftui-render/src/frame_guardrails.rs`: doc.
- `crates/ftui-demo-showcase/src/app.rs`: `emit_*_jsonl` helpers write through `evidence_sink()` when configured (keeps their current stdout/file behaviour otherwise).

## Success criteria

- [ ] `program::tests::guardrails_receive_live_queue_depth` (`g20-tests`): with the `EffectQueue` backend and N in-flight tasks, `guardrails.snapshot().queue_depth == N` after `render_frame`.
- [ ] `program::tests::voi_sample_written_for_inline_auto`: headless inline-auto program with a file sink produces >= 1 `voi_sample` line whose `decision` is one of the four values and whose `alpha`/`beta` match the sampler posterior.
- [ ] `telemetry_schema::tests::all_targets_include_guardrails_and_a11y`, `all_evidence_events_are_unique_and_snake_case`.
- [ ] `evidence_lines_all_carry_schema_version` (`g20-tests`) over a headless run exercising every emitter reachable headlessly.
- [ ] bd-1za0z item (3) referenced in the close reason with the test name.

## Tests and logging

Unit tests inline (`program.rs` test module already has `temp_evidence_path`/`read_evidence_event` helpers at :9808-9842 and :12201-12224); the `voi_sample` line is logged at `tracing::debug!(target: TARGET_VOI, ..)` too (existing `ftui.voi` records at `voi_sampling.rs:575-644` stay). E2E validation is `g20-impl-json-schema`.

## Dependencies and ordering

Blocked by nothing. Unblocks `g20-impl-schema-constants`, `g20-impl-json-schema`, `g20-tests`, `g20-docs`, `g19-impl`, and cluster C's `g09-impl-runtime`, `g10-impl-voi`, `g11-impl`.

## Considerations, risks, alternatives rejected

- Rejected: emitting `voi_decision` and `voi_observe` as two separate events (the README names one category; two lines per decision doubles volume and complicates the schema); the observation is nested.
- Risk: evidence volume in inline-auto (one line per decision at up to the frame rate); the sink's `max_bytes` (50 MiB default, `evidence_sink.rs:25`) bounds it and the E2E run is 3.2 s.
- Risk: `queue_telemetry()` is process-global; in tests running in parallel the depth may include other tests' tasks — the queue-depth test uses the `EffectQueue` backend with its own counter or serializes with the existing test lock.

## Definition of done

Reachable from the production render path (`voi_sample` in inline-auto runs, live queue depth every frame); tests above green; close reason names them and states "closes bd-1za0z item (3)"; clippy/fmt/check clean.

# task(G20): Adopt telemetry_schema constants for every tracing target (parallel subagents, no scripts)

## Context and why this matters

README.md:676-690 states "All runtime telemetry uses canonical targets and event names defined in `ftui_runtime::telemetry_schema`". Vision row V54 rates this PARTIAL: "constants unused; literals match". The literals match today by discipline only; a typo in any of the 60-odd sites would silently create a new target that no subscriber filters on, and the README's "canonical" claim is untestable. The bridge plan says the fix is a "mechanical edit across files, done by parallel subagents per AGENTS.md, not a script" — AGENTS.md "Code Editing Discipline: NEVER run a script that processes/changes code files in this repo ... For many simple changes: use parallel subagents". This bead is that edit, plus the reconciliation of the second constants module the audit found.

## Current state (evidence)

Literal `"ftui.*"` strings outside `telemetry_schema.rs` (rg over `crates`, 2026-09-01):

- Tracing targets in production code:
  - `crates/ftui-runtime/src/program.rs`: `"ftui.runtime"` at :2736, :2826, :2882, :3410, :3420, :3431, :3542, :3558, :3571, :4906; `"ftui.effect"` at :3858; `"ftui.guardrails"` at :6155, :6188 (undeclared until `g20-impl`).
  - `crates/ftui-runtime/src/effect_system.rs`: `"ftui.effect"` at :103, :307, :316, :339, :364, :383, :395, :405.
  - `crates/ftui-runtime/src/process_subscription.rs`: `"ftui.process"` at :209, :220, :266, :274, :286, :299, :312, :357.
  - `crates/ftui-runtime/src/subscription.rs`: `"ftui.runtime"` at :429, :450.
  - `crates/ftui-runtime/src/resize_coalescer.rs`: `"ftui.decision.resize"` at :1769, :1791.
  - `crates/ftui-runtime/src/voi_sampling.rs`: `"ftui.voi"` at :575, :590, :644 (and test comparisons at :2025, :2060, :2089, :2135).
  - `crates/ftui-runtime/src/eprocess_throttle.rs`: `"ftui.eprocess"` at :382, :397, :408 (module is DEAD and slated for quarantine/merge under G07/G13; convert anyway, or skip if deleted first).
  - `crates/ftui-runtime/src/bocpd.rs`: `"ftui.bocpd"` at :746, :757, :768.
  - `crates/ftui-demo-showcase/src/app.rs`: `"ftui.perf_hud"` at :3563, :5249, :5391, :5403; `"ftui.explainability_cockpit"` at :3619, :5666 (undeclared anywhere).
- Span names as literals: `program.rs` `ftui.program.init` (:5249), `ftui.program.update` (:5414, :5762, :5891, :5923, :6091), `ftui.program.shutdown` (:5526), `ftui.program.subscriptions` (:5810), `ftui.program.error` (:5858), `ftui.render.frame` (:6315), `ftui.render.present` (:6347), `ftui.program.view` (:6576, :6638); `terminal_writer.rs` `ftui.render.present` (:1168, :1291), `ftui.render.scroll_region` (:1817), `ftui.render.diff_compute` (:1865, :1993), `ftui.render.emit` (:1875, :2022).
- A second constants module: `crates/ftui-runtime/src/telemetry.rs:834-883` (`names` consts `PROGRAM_INIT`, `PROGRAM_UPDATE`, `PROGRAM_VIEW`, `PROGRAM_SUBSCRIPTIONS`, `RENDER_FRAME`, `RENDER_DIFF`, `RENDER_PRESENT`, `RENDER_FLUSH`, `INPUT_EVENT`, `INPUT_MACRO`, `DECISION_DEGRADATION`, `DECISION_FALLBACK`, `DECISION_RESIZE = "ftui.decision.resize"`, `DECISION_SCREEN_MODE`, `SCHEMA_VERSION = "ftui.schema_version"`), also unused by the span sites.
- Integration tests with literal span/target names: `crates/ftui-runtime/tests/e2e_observability_pipeline.rs` (:463-:1262), `tracing_span_hierarchy.rs` (:240-:1643), `log_level_policy_compliance.rs` (:836, :850).
- `telemetry_schema.rs` is referenced only by `lib.rs:83` and the showcase test `mega_telemetry_schema_constant_stable` (`mermaid_mega_showcase.rs:7501`).

## Target state

One canonical module: `ftui_runtime::telemetry_schema` holds every target (`TARGET_*`), every span name (`span::PROGRAM_INIT` .. `span::RENDER_EMIT`, moved from `telemetry.rs::names` — `telemetry.rs` keeps no duplicate definitions; if `telemetry.rs::names` must remain a path for the `telemetry` feature's exporter, it re-exports `pub use crate::telemetry_schema::span::*`), and every evidence event name (`evidence::*`, from `g20-impl`). Every site listed above uses the constant (`tracing::info!(target: telemetry_schema::TARGET_RUNTIME, ..)`, `info_span!(telemetry_schema::span::PROGRAM_INIT)`), including the three integration test files. Showcase-owned targets `ftui.perf_hud` and `ftui.explainability_cockpit` get constants in the showcase (`crates/ftui-demo-showcase/src/app.rs` top-level `const TARGET_PERF_HUD`/`TARGET_EXPLAINABILITY_COCKPIT`) and are documented as app-level targets, not runtime schema. A test proves no literal remains.

## Implementation plan

1. Prerequisite (`g20-impl`): `TARGET_GUARDRAILS`, `TARGET_A11Y`, `evidence` module exist. This bead first adds `pub mod span { .. }` to `telemetry_schema.rs` with the names from `telemetry.rs:834-883` and rewires `telemetry.rs` to re-export (or delete its duplicates — that is in-file code removal, not file deletion).
2. Dispatch parallel subagents, one per file, each with the exact line list above and the instruction to edit by hand (Edit tool), never with sed/awk/ast-grep rewrite mode: `program.rs`, `effect_system.rs`, `process_subscription.rs`, `subscription.rs`, `resize_coalescer.rs`, `voi_sampling.rs`, `eprocess_throttle.rs` (if still present), `bocpd.rs`, `terminal_writer.rs`, showcase `app.rs`, and the three `tests/*.rs` files. Each subagent runs `cargo check -p ftui-runtime --all-targets` (or `-p ftui-demo-showcase`) before reporting.
3. Note for `tracing` macros: `target:` must be a `&'static str` constant expression; `info_span!(NAME)` accepts a `const &str`; `tracing::span!(target: .., Level::.., NAME)` likewise. If a site builds a target dynamically, leave it and record why.
4. Add the guard test in `telemetry_schema.rs`: `no_stray_target_literals` reads every `.rs` under `crates/ftui-runtime/src`, `crates/ftui-runtime/tests`, `crates/ftui-render/src`, `crates/ftui-core/src`, `crates/ftui-demo-showcase/src` at test time (`std::fs`, paths relative to `CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR/..`), and asserts no line outside `telemetry_schema.rs` and the showcase constants block contains the byte sequence `"ftui.` (allowlist file `docs/telemetry-target-literal-allowlist.txt`, empty at the end of this bead, may only shrink).
5. Once G06's `scripts/check_readme_claims.py` exists, add the same rule there (the plan puts the CI grep in that script); until then the unit test is the gate.
6. Do NOT: write a sed/perl/python rewrite; introduce a `telemetry_schema_v2`; keep both `telemetry.rs::names` definitions and `telemetry_schema::span` as separate literals; change any target string value (renames are out of scope; the README table must stay true).
7. `cargo check --workspace --all-targets`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo fmt --check`, `ubs` on every changed file.

## Files to change

- `crates/ftui-runtime/src/telemetry_schema.rs`: `span` module, guard test, allowlist reader.
- `crates/ftui-runtime/src/telemetry.rs`: names re-exported from `telemetry_schema`.
- `crates/ftui-runtime/src/{program,effect_system,process_subscription,subscription,resize_coalescer,voi_sampling,eprocess_throttle,bocpd,terminal_writer}.rs`: constants at the listed lines.
- `crates/ftui-runtime/tests/{e2e_observability_pipeline,tracing_span_hierarchy,log_level_policy_compliance}.rs`: constants.
- `crates/ftui-demo-showcase/src/app.rs`: showcase target constants.
- `docs/telemetry-target-literal-allowlist.txt` (new, empty; exists so the test has a shrink-only baseline).

## Success criteria

- [ ] `telemetry_schema::tests::no_stray_target_literals` passes with an empty allowlist.
- [ ] `rg -n '"ftui\.' crates --glob '*.rs' | rg -v telemetry_schema.rs | rg -v 'app.rs:.*const TARGET_'` returns nothing (recorded in the close reason).
- [ ] `tracing_span_hierarchy` and `e2e_observability_pipeline` integration tests still pass (they assert the same strings through constants now).
- [ ] `mega_telemetry_schema_constant_stable` still passes.

## Tests and logging

The guard test prints every offending `file:line: text` before failing. No runtime behaviour changes; span/target strings are byte-identical before and after (asserted by the integration tests).

## Dependencies and ordering

Blocked by `g20-impl` (targets and evidence module). Unblocks `g20-tests` (guard test is exercised there) and `g20-docs` (README table lists the declared targets). Interacts with `g07-impl`/`g13-impl` (cluster A/C) for `eprocess_throttle.rs`: whichever lands first, the other adapts; no conflict in principle.

## Considerations, risks, alternatives rejected

- Rejected: an `ast-grep` rewrite run (`ast-grep run --rewrite`); AGENTS.md's script prohibition covers automated code transformation, and the file count (14) is small enough for subagents.
- Risk: merge conflicts with concurrent work in `program.rs`; the edits are one-token changes at known lines and rebase cleanly; subagents must re-read the file before editing (other agents change files continuously, per AGENTS.md's note).
- Risk: `tracing` `target:` requires a literal-like constant; the constants are `pub const &str`, which the macros accept.

## Definition of done

Every site converted by hand, guard test green with an empty allowlist, integration tests green, clippy/fmt/check clean, close reason lists the subagent-edited files and the `rg` result.
close_reason: Landed in dc7ef40c: telemetry_schema now holds span (15 runtime span names) and decision (4 event names), moved from the duplicate telemetry.rs module which re-exports them; every tracing target and span-name literal in the runtime (program, effect_system, process_subscription, subscription, resize_coalescer, voi_sampling, eprocess_throttle, bocpd, terminal_writer) and the integration tests (e2e_observability_pipeline, tracing_span_hierarchy, log_level_policy_compliance, e2e_effect_system_cancellation, bocpd_unit_tests) uses the constant; showcase perf_hud and explainability_cockpit targets got app-level constants. Guard test no_stray_target_literals scans runtime/core/render/showcase sources and fails on any complete ftui.<name> schema literal outside the module, the showcase block, or docs/telemetry-target-literal-allowlist.txt. String values unchanged. Verified: workspace check + clippy -D warnings + fmt; the 9 schema tests and 28 telemetry.rs tests pass. Edits by hand (parallel subagents), no scripts.
